Scabandari Bloodeye
Tiste Edur with ‘hammered iron’ colored skin, long grey hair, gaunt, aquiline nose, high brow, close set eyes, broad downturned mouth with no lines
Eleint Soletaken, iron-hued wings with ice blue eyes
Two handed sword on a leather harness, long-knives at his hips, scaled cape made from a matron that still has natural oils on it
Silchas Ruin
Tiste Andii, albino. Pallid skin, glowing red eyes, long white hair. A head taller than Scabandari
Eleint Soletaken, larger than Scabandari. Bone white color
Scabbards empty, broke two swords invested with sorcery
Both Scabandari and Silchas Ruin semble to their Tiste forms on a mountain of KCCM corpses
The Edur came too late, resulting in more Andii deaths
They had come to secure the path to the [mortal] world to plunder it for their empires
The KCCM are gone, only a city remains on Morn, on a distant continent (Note: South Genabackis).
The Short-Tailed KCCM are rebelling there
Scabandari Bloodeye thinks the other races won’t oppose them
Jaghut: Scattered and too few
Imass: Flint weapons against their iron
Forkrul Assail: Seem unwilling to pass judgment on them, and their numbers are dwindling
Kurald Galain is in civil war, Kurald Emurlahn is shattering because of Scabandari
Silchas senses a Jaghut in the distance ritual casting Omtose Phellack
Silchas gives the nickname ‘Bloodeye’ to Scabandari because he has a bloodlust
As Silchas looked north towards the Jaghut, Scabandari takes a shadow-etched sorcerous dagger from his boot and stabs Silchas in the back
The Edur slaughter the remaining Andii
Scabandari wants to rule in the mortal world by himself and plans to kill the rest of the Andii here
The known/speculated fragments of Kurald Emurlahn thus far is the Nascent, pieces around Tremorlor, and the Whirlwind being the largest fragment
The Tiste Edur, Children of Shadow, whose ancestral warren is Kurald Emurlahn, wants to gain the Throne of Shadow on Drift Avalii and reunite all the fragments
Anomander Rake left his brother Andarist and his grandchildren to defend the Throne of Shadow

Memories of Ice
When exploring the Barghast dugouts beneath Capustan (Genabackis), the Barghast were revealed to be a seafaring people from the Blue Wastes, the Barghast birth realm
Barghast carvings on the ships showed a singular enemy, the T’isten’ur, or Tiste Edur, that the Barghast Founding Spirits drove back into the Forest of Shadows
Elingarth had similar stories about the Tiste Edur and the Forest of Shadows
The Moranth speak the holy tongue of the Barghast shouldermen, claim kinship to the Barghast and call the Barghast are their fallen kin, embraced the alchemies and traded secrets with the T’isten’ur
Twist, a black Moranth, reveals that Barghast came to Moranth wood and found Tiste Edur living in a Kurald Emurlahn fragment
The Tiste Edur died, but helped shaped the Barghast into the Moranth they are today

Paran and Quick Ben find a Tiste Edur corpse they thought was killed by Ruse, Path of the Sea, and become aware that the Tiste Edur are probably active again because of Shadowthrone usurping the Throne of Shadow
Paran gets transported to the Throne of Shadow on Drift Avalii and is told that it begs Anomander Rake’s help for defense against the Tiste Edur
House of Chains
The Unbound Renegade T’lan Imass (the Seven Faces in the Rock) blamed the Tiste Edur for their failures
Trull explains to Onrack that the the Tiste Edur and T’lan Imass rarely interacted.
Most T’lan would turn away, other T’lan that traveled with Thelomen Toblakai would fight the Edur

The Tiste Edur came from Mother Dark, and were banished and pursued by the first wave of Tiste Andii until the Edur killed all their pursuers. More Tiste Andii found the Edur later on, but cared little
The Edur had lived without knowing their past, and Trull wished it stayed that way
The Edur now move with purpose, along with a few other T’lan Imass
The Tiste Edur pursued the Throne of Shadow on Drift Avalii, killed Anomander Rake’s brother Andarist and some stranded Malazans including Admiral Nok’s wife Hawl.
The Traveler becomes the new protector of the Throne of Shadow
The Tiste Edur sought the Throne of Shadow to unite the shattered fragments of Kurald Emurlahn
An outsider manipulates the Tiste Edur
Onrack realizes that the Unbound and the Tiste Edur serve the same master, and that they are attempting to seat a mortal Tiste Edur on the First Throne (which commands the T’lan Imass)
Scabandari can’t kill Silchas, so he binds him in sorcerous chains, flies him south in eleint form to leave him in an Azath tower
Mother Dark’s three children are now gone
Andarist: surrendered power to answer an eternal grief, not knowing the grief was caused by Scabandari
(Note: Was guardian to the Throne of Shadow on Drift Avalii, Tiste Edur killed him in House of Chains)
Anomandaris Irake: separated from his mother and people, vanished
Silchas Ruin: imprisoned in the Azath tower just now by Scabandari
The narrative voice claims Scabandari’s folly in not accounting for Rake, and that’s not even his biggest mistake
Gothos, Jaghut, stands on a glacial berm watching the battle and Scabandari kill Silchas
(Note: Presenttime is imprisoned in an Azath House on the Jhag Odhan where Karsa met the tree Jaghut, Phyrlis. He is also the guardian of the Deadhouse in Malaz City where he met Crokus and Apsalar)
Mael, Elder God of the Seas, comes and beseeches him to preserve the land instead of cleansing (destroying) everything, but doesn’t give a reason
Mentions Kilmandaros as his ally
They are aware that Anomander Rake is awakening in a distant land, with Osserc moving to get in his way
1159 Year of Burn’s Sleep
Withal the Swordmaker wakes up in the Crippled God’s warren after his home, the third floating Meckros city, was destroyed by a colossal piece of ice that emerged from below
[Note: Never explicitly stated anywhere in the series, but I’m assuming that Meckros people are human]
Withal walked inland until he came to the Crippled God’s tent where he had a crystal bottle of spring water, dried fruit, dark bread, and a brazier to throw seeds for a numbing effect
The Crippled God prepared for Withal’s arrival with a forge and three Nacht, Jaghut creations that are similar to bhok’aral and can function as servants
Rind, Mape, Pule

1161 Burn’s Sleep
A narrator tells a tale of a giant, one of many that fell from the sky and knelt to turn into mountains
The giant stood on a beach and became obsessed with the sea
He lay down on the beach to sleep and drowned.
The sea minerals turned the giant into rock, and the tides eroded away at his features until he was shapeless
To see him, ‘one must look in darkness’, look away and focus on everything but the giant
This is a gift from Father Shadow. Look away to see and you’ll be led into Shadow where all truths hide
(Note: I came back to this after finishing MT and I still dunno what it means)
While gathering raw jade pieces from the shoreline of the seal breeding beds of Calach Bay, Trull Sengar witnesses the Letherii illegally hunting seals in Edur territory, violating the treaty
Trull returns just as his brother Binadas was leaving. They exchanged few words
In the training compound, Trull saw his older brother Fear lead the training for young warriors
Rhulad, the youngest brother, spars with his friend Midik Bhun
Fear’s fiance, Mayen, is on her way to the market with four women and a dozen slaves. Pauses to watch Fear’s training
Before Rhulad could say something to Mayen, Trull invites him to bring news to their father
This invitation is only meant for ‘blooded’ warriors who have killed
Trull and Rhulad walks to the Sengar family longhouse, where iron weapons decorated the walls
When Father Shadow disappeared, the knowledge of forging iron weapons was also lost
In a blackwood tree beyond the hearth was a ‘true Emurlahn’ iron blade, sword of the Sengar family
Their mother Uruth worked on a tapestry with slaves depicting the Sengar family’s involvement with the War of Unification
Trull reports to his father, Tomad Sengar who was playing a game with three nobles, about the Letherii illegal seal hunting
Ran 3 days and 2 nights from Calach Bay
Rhulad makes an inappropriate outburst, Tomad sends him away to report the news to Hannan Mosag
Tomad is upset Trull brought Rhulad, an unblooded warrior, to this meeting
Hannan Mosag is calling a council meeting at midnight, he has a task for the four Sengar brothers
Calach Bay
Father Shadow
Sheltatha Lore, Daughter Dusk. The favoured daughter.
Sukul Ankhadu, Daughter of Deceit, aka Dapple
Menandore, Daughter of Dawn

Hiroth Village
Can be considered a city with 20,000 Edur and 60,000 Letherii residents
Winter is ending and still weeks away from planting
The Edur women supervise their slaves when harvesting

Hannan Mosag, Warlock King of the Hiroth, united in the six Edur tribes in the War of Unification and ruled as dictator by holding hostage the firstborn sons of the Edur chiefs, known as his K’risnan Cadre
Food storages were empty because of the War of Unification
The Avenue of the Warlock leads to Hiroth’s inner ward with the training compound, noble district, and Hannan Mosag’s massive citadel
Lined with thousand year old Blackwood trees, invested with sorcery to emit a shroud of gloom over the street. They looked more like pillars, as the branches were only at the top of the trees
A tunnel of blackwood trees leads to a bridge over a canal, with a dozen K’orthan raider longboats, to the training compound, barracks, storehouses, and noble residential district
A second bridge leads to the actual citadel
Tomad Sengar, father Uruth Sengar, mother
Fear Sengar, first born Trull Sengar, second Binadas Sengar, third Rhulad Sengar, fourth
First and eldest son
Weapons Master of the Hiroth
Betrothed to Mayen
Has the most raid trophies out of the four brothers
Second son
Participated in the War of Unification, where the Hiroth tribe subjugated the other five Edur tribes
Has a belt of 21 red rivets for each coup of the war, 7 has white circles signifying actual kills
Does not like fighting
The War of Unification had just ended, Trull feels anxiety to be thrown in a new one
House of Chains
Was Shorn by his people
Third son
Head taller than his older brother, Trull
Most remote and evasive of the brothers, hard to predict
Spends more time in the wilds of the forests and mountains than time at home in the Hiroth village
Rarely participated in raids, but always brought home a trophy (kill) when he does
Fourth and youngest son
Unblooded, has yet to kill or earn a trophy
Was born too late to participate in the War of Unification, eager to prove himself
Flirted with Mayen, his eldest brother Fear’s betrothed, to the point of being inappropriate, but is always doted on by Fear
Unable to sleep before the midnight council, Trull Sengar walks along the beach accompanied by a white crow
This upcoming spring will be the first to restore their food supply after burning through it for the war, another reason why the Letherii illegal hunting hurt the Edur even more
Other tribes were forced to swear fealty to King Ezgara Diskanar of Lether to prevent other independent ships in their territories
Fear Sengar approaches Trull
Reports Trull’s news has roused the Edur warriors but Hannan Mosag ‘knows to look away’
The Warlock King has blood memory visions all the way back to Father Shadow and the Dark Times
The Dark Times was when Kurald Emurlahn shattered, now ruled by false kings and gods. The Tiste Edur were still able to access sorcery however
The Tiste Edur are bitter over lost glory. Scabandari Bloodeye was betrayed by kin and the Tiste Andii which led to the loss of the Hounds and the Throne to Kurald Emurlahn
Trull doesn’t like fighting, Fear mentions that Rhulad sees Trull as weak
Trull walks eggshells around Rhulad because of his attention to his brother’s fiance.
But Trull can’t say anything because it’s Fear’s responsibility. But also, Mayen doesn’t ever appear to be that attached to Fear in the first place and seems to only act out of propriety
Trull doesn’t care to prove Rhulad wrong, Fear argues that Trull has a responsibility as the older brother to guide him
They go together to the King’s Hall for the council
Because they turned away from the water, they didn't see a pale winged shape flying in the distance
Udinaas was born into indentured servitude inherited down from several generations
13 years prior, Udinaas was a sailor on a whaler ship to a merchant, Intaros of Trate, that got caught stealing pigs from the Edur
The officers and captain of the ship were fed to the sharks and dhenrabi, while sailors became slaves
Udinaas was a Letherii slave of the Sengar household, which was decent because obedience gave protection, shelter, clothing, and plenty of food
Udinaas had little reason to escape. He was surrounded by plenty of other Letherii and he hated the sea
His duties were to repair nets
Udinaas watched Trull and Fear return from the beach to attend the midnight council
He wished the Edur well in fighting back against the Letherii, the slaves are the first to suffer from the food shortage
Udinaas view Letherii as a people completely revolved around gold, defined their lives from power, respect, self-worth, relationship, motivation
Hulad, a slave of the Buhn household, passes by and says Feather Witch is casting at night
Udinaas sees a pale shape flying over the water and it frightened
With his left hand he draws an ‘invoking sigil’ in the sand, and with his right closes his eyelids as he says a prayer to the Errant
The King’s Meet/Hall, a circular Blackwood chamber where the audience was separated into several rings
Unblooded warriors on the outermost ring > Matrons/wedded/widowed women > Unwedded and betrothed > Warriors, inner ring was a pit > K’risnan hostages on a dais > Hannan Mosag at the center
Hannan Mosag is a plain man of average height and build, wide cast eyes that looked perpetually surprised
Rich and deep voice
Hulking wraith bodyguard in helm, plated armor, and long swords in his shadow
Trull looks on the hostage from the Merude tribe and thought how they could’ve easily been the dominant among the six Edur tribes far
Hannan Mosag simply walked into Chief Hanradi Khalag’s longhouse and by dawn, the chief had surrendered the Merude tribe
The Merude first born was bald to show he was removed from his tribe, scars ribboned his face, eyes watchful as if anticipating something
Hannan Mosag speaks: Rhulad reports of Trull’s sightings in Calach Bay and invites Trull Sengar to speak
Trull climbs onto the dais and sits to the right of Hannan Mosag
Trull reports 19 Letherii ships, 70 men on the shore collecting hundreds of beaten tusked seals
Trull lost his spear after he threw it in one of the Letherii’s chest
Hannan Mosag believes the Letherii anticipated violent retaliation and plans to use it as leverage at the Great Meeting
Hannan Mosag plans to have his K’risnan, apprentices in his sorcery, unleash a full unveiling of Kurald Emurlahn on the Letherii raiders
A full unveiling hasn’t been done since Scabandari Bloodeye
Udinaas runs into a barn where a crowd of a hundred slaves watch Feather Witch perform a casting of the Tiles of the Holds
Feather Witch was an 18 year old girl who could speak to their ancestors. She was handmaiden to Mayen and Udinaas is hopelessly in love with her
Udinaas tells his friend Hulad that he saw a white crow, the people around them get nervous
Feather Witch moaned, her eyes turned a spiralling white, a terrified expression, her thoughts flowed through the Abyss to witness the Holds and she divines the Tiles
Lists the Fulcra (unaligned), the Holds, the positions in each hold
(Link to the full casting notes)
Feather Witch is cut off as an invisible wyval, spawn of elein, stabs talons into her shoulders and lifts her up
Udinaas runs through the panicked crowd and grabs the wyval, it bits Udinaas’ left shoulder
Udinaas uses his net hook to slash the wyval’s leg, releasing Feather Witch
The wyval impales Udinaas with its talons, bites his neck filling his mouth and nose with blood
As Udinaas blacks out, the wyval lets go and screams in pain
Deadhouse Gates
At the bottom of Tesem Temple (where the Path of Hands was located) were carved flagstones of an Elder, raw elemental, version of the Deck of Dragons. The Holds.
In the First Empire ruins where the Beast Ritual was performed, Heboric saw and recognized a temple that had the Holds carved into it
Death/Life, Dark/Light, the Beast Hold
The Antlered throne was empty/unoccupied and flanked by a T’lan Imass

When Paran traveled the Finnest House guarded by Raest, he used his powers as Master of the Deck to enter a card into the Beast Hold where he found twin antlered thrones of bones on a dais of Imass skulls
When inside Dragnipur, Paran spoke to Draconus who said the wagon held the Gate to Kurald Galain ever fleeing from Chaos
Togg (who was lost in the Chaos warren and entered Toc the Younger’s body who was thrown in by Hairlock) and Fanderay (who was inside the Ay Baaljagg) had reunited and reclaimed the Beast Thrones
The midnight council ends, Hannan Mosag keeps the three Sengar brothers as everyone else leaves
Hannan Mosag apologizes to Trull when he made it sound like it was his fault the Letherii can use the murder against them, Trull says no worries
Hannan Mosag brings them to his private chambers where he tells them about a dream three nights ago about an ice spear to the northeast. A gift for the Warlock King
Tasks them to journey with two others to retrieve the gift, but must wrap it in hides and not make physical contact
Fear chooses Theradas Buhn and Midik Buhn
A K’risnan stands at the entrance to the private chambers beckoning them
Wraiths surround Udinaas’ soul, disperses when Feather Witch approaches
Feather Witch can see the love Udinaas has for her
Uruth Momma Sengar unleashed Kurald Emurlahn and drove the wyval away
Udinaas and Feather Witch are laying side-by-side, unconscious and being healed
Feather Witch is keeping them both unconscious because she senses corruption in Kurald Emurlahn
Feather Witch tells them to keep this conversation secret when they wake up
Udinaas feels another heartbeat in the distance and feels terror
Hannan Mosag and the Sengar boys watch Momma Sengar heal Udinaas and Feather Witch
Gold wyval blood stains Udinaas’s shirt and flows through his veins
Uruth thinks that if Feather Witch can hid her sorcery while unconscious, then she is more powerful than Uruth is
Udinaas and Feather Witch slowly wake up, Hannan Mosag and his K’risnan leaves
Hannan Mosag’s wraith pauses at the doorway and looks at one of them before leaving
Seren Pedac is one of seven Acquitors allowed to guide merchants into Edur territory
Seren is into 6 out of 10 years of the contract with Buruk the Pale
Three wagons with trade goods with 90 iron ingots, with a team of Nerek tribesmen laborers, half naked despite the cold
Traveling through the snowy mountain pass, with the Reach Inlet to their west
Buruk steps out of his wagon, is enamoured with the vista, and decides to camp there
Seren Pedac walked up the trail to an old shrine, where the wall of the mountain was cut out and boulders outlined the remains of two ships, menhirs marked the prow and bow
Father Shadow was carved on the prow menhir, features eroded by wind
The sheer walls were like panels of obsidian, touching them would heal her she discovered long ago

The Nerek tribe believed they were the children of a female human and a male serpent, and each person has a respect in their curved spines. They used to bury their dead beneath flat stones. But the Letherii outlawed their faith and imposed the faith of the Holds
Now Nerek tribes were dying out, one quarters of the village would die out, diseased rats infested their homes, and the Letherii only offered debt and dissolution
Seren Pedac saw flowing shapes in the translucent stone walls and wished to join them in peace
Seren Pedac and Buruk are sitting at their campfire, Hull Beddict approaches from the wild and joins them
Buruk had secret instructions giving him crippling anxiety
Buruk leaves so Seren and Hull could speak alone
Hull and Seren discuss Buruk being the Letherii emissary to the Great Meeting
Hull thinks King Diskanar is planning to use the ‘unsanctioned seal hunting’ as an excuse to revise the Edur-Letherii treaty and bribe the Warlock King with gold
Nifadas, the First Eunuch, and Prince Quillas lead the delegation
Queen Janall is the primary interest holder in the seven merchant houses who keeps Prince Quillas on a short leash, and the Chancellor Triban Gnol whispers sweet words in his ears to manipulate him
12 years ago King Ezgara Diskanar tasked Preda of the Guard, Hull Beddict, to become Sentinel
(Note: Preda ≈ Fist, or commander. Sentinel is the position to study and make first contact with non-Letherii)
Hull believed it a mission of peaceful co-existence with northern tribes, gave reports about the Nerek (human), Faraed (human), and Tarthenal (non-human), the royal council used it to subjugate them
Hull watched as tribes he bonded with succumbed to debt and the poisons of civilization
Tribe people still worship Hull and share the three bar tattoo on Hull’s back
Broken-hearted, Hull gave up being Sentinel and disappeared into the forest never to return to the Lether Kingdom
Seren Pedac found Hull Beddict 8 years ago and ‘brought him home’ for her own selfish gain. Doesn’t know if she was ever forgiven
Hull Beddict has away too long to understand the intricate schemes and sleight of hand of the Letherii
Reach Inlet
Tehol and Bugg on their rooftop bed and stool watch the Eternal Domicile be constructed in the distance
Bugg mentions three ladies came to visit this morning, Tehol wraps his bedsheet around him like a skirt and goes to Huldo’s restaurant to meet them
Makes small talk with a guard, Chalas, on the way
Tehol finds them and the ladies, ‘from the islands’, are disappointed in what they saw
Rissarh. Red hair with blue eyes and a heroic statuesque face, find drinking straight from the bottle
Hejun. Faraed blooded, honeyed hue skin, faint up-tilt of her dark eyes. Dark brown/black hair tied up revealing her heart shaped face
Shand. Shaved bald, pale skin, wide-set light grey eyes
The ladies want in on a money scheme Tehol pulled off and wants him to go even further
They bought a building and suggest they continue their conversation there
They attempt to threaten him by saying if he doesn't Hull will kill him

At the height of their power, they were all about wealth, and looting everything they could in the Mediterranean and beyond. It was a great metaphor for capitalism itself, they had to keep building on top of the foundations that keep sinking into the mud.
Nifadas, First Eunuch, brings his concerns of Hull Beddict complicating the Great Meeting to Brys Beddict, Hull’s younger brother and Finadd of the Royal Guard and the King’s Champion
(Note: Finadd ≈ Captain. King’s Champion is the King’s personal bodyguard, free to speak his mind)
Nifadas respects Hull and his choice to leave
Brys make it firm that he has no idea what either of his brothers are up to
Nifadas says they’re aware Buruk has secret instructions and that might be against the King’s interests
Hints that he wants Hull to ‘deflect’ the instructions’ intent away from the King or his advisers
Nifadas asks if he knows anything about Seren Pedac, Brys doesn’t
Brys leaves Nifadas’ office
Brys thinks upon his brothers
Brys admired Hull and that he actually does understand him
Brys understands Tehol less. Tehol had ‘died’ in the Letherii primal desire for wealth, and was smiling when he pulled off whatever scheme he did
Ceda Kuru Qan brings Brys into his office
(Note: Ceda ≈ High Mage)
Kuru Qan invented glasses that comically magnifies his eyes
Studying the Empty Hold ‘stole his sight’
Brys likes Kuru Qan
Kuru Qan drinks a liquid from a beaker and says Brys could come back after he sees the Preda
Brys leaves Kuru Qan’s office
Brys enters the old throne room (currently being moved to the Eternal Domicile), Preda Unnutal Hebaz waits inside
40 years old, almost as tall as Brys. Fair skin, blonde hair, dark hazel eyes
Unnutal chastises Brys for being late and orders home to stand in his guards position
Moroch Nevath, Prince Quillas’s Guardsman, enters first
The ‘squalid nest’ enters, the other side of the king’s advisers
Prince Quillas Diskanar
Chancellor Triban Gnol
Queen Janall
The Queen’s First Consort, Turudal Brizad
Prince Quillas is mad that Preda Unnutal Hebaz sent Finadd Gerun Eberict to be a part of the Nifadas’ entourage and demanded she send him back
Preda Unnutal stands firm that she listens to the king and no one else
Moroch steps forward threateningly, Brys steps silently and instantly unsheathes his sword.
Preda Unnutal points at Brys, subtly stopping him before he kills Moroch and scaring Moroch
The Queen underhandedly insults Unnutal and the squalid nest leaves
Unnutal says she should've let Brys kill him and she leaves
Brys leaves to Ceda Kuru Qan’s office
Preda Commander of the Army
Atri-Preda Commander of a City
Ceda High Mage
Atri-Ceda Commander of the mages
Finadd Captain
Kuru Qan was dancing as he waited for Brys and walks him through several corridors to the Cedance, Kuru Qan’s divination chamber
Massive copper doors to circular chamber with a walkway suspended by chains, hanging over luminescent tiles arranged in a spiral, that leading to the central platform.
Kuru Qan asks Brys to look at the Tiles
First: ‘a barrow in a yard’
Barrow, third from the last of the Azath Hold tiles
Kuru Qan observes the spiral for past month has always started with the Barrow tile, has visited the Azath tower and grounds, both are unchanged
Second: ‘A gate, formed of a dragon’s gaping jaws’
Gate, fifth in the Dragon Hold. The first time Kuru Qan has seen a Dragon tile in his life
Third: Betrayer of the Empty Hold
Fourth: White Crow, of the Fulcra (unaligned)
Fifth: Seed, last tile of the Ice Hold. Shards of ice
Sixth: Blank, the divination ceases
Brys brings up the prophecy ‘The king who rules at the Seventh Closure shall be transformed and so shall become the First Emperor reborn
Kuru Qan acknowledges that the Kingdom of Lether was a colony of the First Empire, existing in isolation for almost 7,000 years, possibly even 70,000
Kuru Qan has shown Nifadas the tiles in the Cedance
Staring at the blank tile, Brys feels that Hull might kill Prince Quillas

i.html: There are actually two ‘First Empires’. There is the First Empire of the T’lan Imass, and the First Empire of humans which took its name from the former
The First Empire of the T’lan Imass
Gardens of the Moon:
Founded after the Ritual of Telann, Onos T’oolan was the First Sword
Memories of Ice
Kilava Onass, Onos T’oolan’s sister and Onrack the Broken’s lover that drove Onrack’s wife insane, was formerly a part of the First Empire
Deadhouse Gates

The cave ruins that Felisin, Kulp, and Heboric explored after escaping the Nascent was a First Empire city. The city was petrified after performing the Beast Ritual, pursuing the Path of the Soletaken as an alternative means to achieve Ascendancy
The First Empire was founded on Seven Cities, the potsherds belonged to them

Skinny, darker skin than most, green eyes, dark black hair adorned with onyx beads, a seal skin shirt, belt of colorful shells, bracelets and anklets of whale ivory
Trull thinks Mayen knows she's beautiful and wields it like a weapon
The family talks about Hannan Mosag’s assigned journey to the ice fields
Binadas notes there’s slumbering old sorcery and Arapay hunters
Mama Uruth and Papa Tomad argue about Hannan Mosag’s intentions and if he’ll win the war
Rhulad keeps talking big about the dangers they face, which pisses Tomad enough to slam the table that lifts all the platters
Trull notices a wry smile on Mayen
Rhulad gets angry and thinks he’s going to be Hannan Mosag’s virgin sacrifice to bed Father Shadow’s daughters to bless the war
Udinaas startles and drops a plate, revealing his skinned palms
The other slaves shout that he fought the wyval
Uruth placed her hand on Udinaas’s head, surrounding him with sorcery until he spasms and KO’s, and determines nothing is inside him
Feather Witch and another slave drags Udinaas elsewhere to treat him
Uruth wants Udinaas punished for handling their plates with open wounds on his hands, Mayen retorts ‘You just raped his mind. Is that not enough?’
After that silence, Tomad expresses his wishes for Rhulad to become blooded alongside his brothers on their journey
Feather Witch angrily slaps Udinaas awake
Udinaas smiles thinking Uruth confirmed he's not possessed
Udinaas openly expresses his love for her, FW says she might as well marry a rat
Udinaas says the Wyval is gone, but the wraith [Wither] hides in his Shadow
Smiling a dark smile, With is his ally to ‘repay debts in full’
Book Two:
Prows of the Day
The Tarancede Tower, one of ten borderland towers, was covered with obsidian plates and the only bordeland tower by the sea
Three harvest ships arrive, but the wind suddenly dies, wraiths appears on the deck, and the alarm bell rings in a panic
All sailors believed in ancient spirits far below the depths of the sea
Superstitions like blood before the bow, dolphins swimming at their sides, or spitting helps keep sailors unnoticed by the spirits
A bound spirit carrying the three ships on its back sails towards Trate harbour
Its enormous size crushed shallow water fish and crustaceans
Crowds watching from the docks all run away in panic
The bound spirit and the ships crash into the harbor, then spirit retreats
From the Cedance, Ceda Kuru Qan witnessed the event unfold and had previously seen a Tile depict the very scene in Trate Harbour
Brys Beddict watches a palace engineer try to figure out how to solve the flooded, rat-infested underground security passages that encircle the Eternal Domicile
The engineer, Grum, mentions ‘Bugg’s Construction’ is working on the last two of the five palace wings
A workman runs out screaming, spooked by Ormly ‘the Catcher’ who wore a cape made of rats
Brys suggests he give Ormly a night off and leaves to find Kuru Qan to maybe them the engineers a mage to help
Brys thinks about the prophecy of entering the Eight Closure and rise of a new glorious empire
Letherii citizens, however, were not enthusiastic and growing more nervous about the treaty meeting
Letheras was able to bribe their way into breaking alliances between their enemies, thought the Edur would fall the same way
Kuru Qan’s divination implied [King Diskanar] would become emperor and the annexation of the Edur is a possibility
Brys returned to the palace and the soldiers were in uproar
News from Trate that the Edur used foul sorcery to slaughter Letherii sailors, the king called for a meeting in two hours
Brys passes by Chancellor Triban Gnol and Turudal Brizad, who are rumored to be bedding each other, and walks into Nifadas’s office
Rulith, barefoot eunuch bodyguards with eyeliner and red painted on their lips into a perpetual grimace
Nifadas wants to know more about what the people worship about the sea since the Letherii doesn't really have an official religion
Brys responds with what he knows
The Tiste Edur calls the dark waters the ‘realm of Galain… for whom Darkness is home’
The Tarthenal think the sea is a single with the river as its countless limbs
The Nerek think the sea is an underworld
The Letherii fear but do not worship the sea. Sacrifices are made for sailors to escape notice
Nifadas speaks on how Lether was a First Empire colony
The First Empire was where the Holds were first discovered, the Empty Hold came later
A theory that each land holds indigenous beliefs support the existence of physical gods
The three Letherii ships were slaughtered, Edur wraiths sailed the ships back to Trate
Nifadas speaks on the Faraed creation myth, a pantheon of aspected Elder Gods
Mael, Elder Lord of the Seas and the Dweller Below, had a physical manifestation after a ‘death of an Age’ [unspecified]
Hannan Mosag may have chained Mael as a mindless demon
The King plans to face Brys awaken an Elder god
Kuru Qan had second thoughts offering a mixed cocktail because the milk curdled, Brys drinks it thinking it was a magic potion
They walk to the Cedance
Kuru Qan recounts that a First Empire port city collapsed after three centuries because they cleared the forest resulting in silts changing the landscape and poor irrigation
The ruins of the port city are now a league away from the coast (an hour’s walk about 3 miles), the land had expanded outwards
Brys looks down and sees the Dolmen Tile, a monolith half submerged and tilted in clay against a void sky
Kuru Qan plans to use the memories that the land clings to
Nifadas and Kuru Qan have no real good reason to specifically send Brys, but no Letherii worship Mael, and Brys is expected to improvise
Kuru Qan grabs Brys’s harness and yeets him off the circular platform into the Dolmen Tile
Tehol tries to cheer Bugg up, who’s disappointed in the trousers he made for Tehol
Tehol and Bugg were able to pull off the Drownings bet-holder’s fake suicide, Gerun Eberict doesn’t suspect foul play and failed to find his money in the bet-holder’s home that was burnt down
Bugg is persuaded to go downstairs to make tea
Tehol looks up at the stars and thinks about the holiday celebration dedicated to the Errant coming up soon
The Letherii worshipped him as an ‘eternally mysterious purveyor of chance, fateful circumstance and ill-chosen impulses’
Shurq Elalle comes to the rooftop two hours early before their beauty appointment with Selush
Shurq goes over Gerun’s estate guard detail
Tehol returns and offers tea made of grey wool
Shurq continues with her report, that Gerun is attending as a guest Turudal Brizad’s celebration event
Shurq shared that she stole his virginity, that he’s narcissistic, and that he’s now older than her because she’s dead and stopped aging
Tehol and Shurq walk over to Selush’s
Shurq doesn’t know if there’s any guards but she goes out of her way to climb down the wall and be stealthy
Selush was an associate of Bugg’s when he was an embalmer, 'exchanging techniques and body parts’
Shurq asks about what Tehol knows about the [Azath] tower
She was the one that named the cursed girl, Kettle, and reveals Kettle is feeding Gerun’s spies to the tower

Tehol collected his cup and cautiously sniffed. Then he frowned at his manservant. Who shrugged. ‘We don't have no herbs, master. I had to improvise.’ ‘With what? Sheep hide?’ Bugg’s brow rose. ‘Very close indeed. I had some leftover wool.’ ‘The yellow or the grey?’ ‘The grey.’ ‘Well, that's alright, then.’ He sipped. ‘Smooth.’ ‘Yes, it would be.’ ‘We’re not poisoning ourselves, are we?’ ‘Only mildly, master.’ ‘There are times,’ Shurq Elalle said, ‘ when I regret being dead. But I am incapable of feeling any more awkward than is my normal state. Secondly, clearing my throat has unpleasant consequences.’

cards.h: Scene 6 (Dolmens under the sea, Brys Beddict)

i.html: Brys stood on the bottom of the ocean floor, able to walk unimpeded and physically breathe in the air of the Cedance chamber
Masses of detritus, armor, and tendrils flowed by him
In the distance, Brys sees dolmens and walks towards them
Brys felt the land’s memory as a plain bathed in sunlight and dry winds
Six dolmens, silvered glyphs carved on them, lined up diagonal from the trench wall

One dolmen had a figure carved in it, multiple limbs, small head, sloping and squat, massive brow ridge over one eye, broad mouth was elongated tendrils with long fangs at the end, six segments arms, two or four legs
Brys sees each dolmen depict a different demon
On the fourth dolmen, the silver wore off the glyphs, a massive hulking creature with tentacle limbs
Brys calls out to Mael, but the Guardian [of the Names] of the dolmens appears
A figure in black armor appears, rusted and covered in barnacles and kelp that clung to it
The figure wield a two handed sword, blood streaned down his gauntlets
Brys wields his sword but the water currents start working against him
The black armored figure reveals Mael offered gods the dolmens so they don't die when they no longer have followers.
The fourth’s dolmen’s named was wiped out and the god was enslaved

cards.h: Scene 6 (Dolmens under the sea, Brys Beddict)

i.html: The Guardian [of the Names] attacks Brys
Brys feels enjoyment in fighting with his life on the line
Brys dodges a horizontal strike and stabs his sword through the Guardian’s left gauntlet plates
A dolmen explodes behind them
Brys dodge rolls away from a downward thrust, the Guardian’s weapon is such in the basalt floor. He's unable to pull it out for the rest of the fight
Brys plants his leg being the Guardian, but fails to shove him over
Brys elbows the Guardian's face and stomped on his leg, snapping the bones above the ankle
The Guardian keeps holding onto the sword and Brys ends the combat
Brys offers his blood to the Guardian and his Letherii steel blade
Mael hasn't visited in thousands of years
The Guardian is amazed how the Letherii steel weighs nothing
Brys cuts his left palm with a dagger and places it on the Guardian’s left hand still gripping the stuck sword
Brys feels his blood drawn into the Guardian who begins to heal
The Guardian [of the Names] gives Brys the names, memories, and visions of the ancient gods
[Note: “Guardian of the Names” is the title the fandom has given him to make things easier]
Brys wakes up in the Cedance, Kuru Qan is aghast at his blood loss
Brys reports the Tiste Edur has enslaved an ancient god, and it'll take time to do through the other gods’ memories to find their name
Bugg walks on Sherp’s Last Lane,
The street named after a crazy man that muttered about a mysterious altar beneath the street
He was found dead in a circle he scratched on the ground and surrounded with rats whose necks he snapped
Bugg sees a dirty child coming from Tehol's Rooftop and leads Bugg into a ruined house where six orphaned Nerek children lived
Their parents had died of Truce Fever, a disease easily cured by any Letherii priest but they demanded coin
The girl took his hand and led Bugg to see their grandmother’s body, who begged Gerun Eberict for money, was stabbed in the chest, and walked 200-300 steps to die surrounded by her grandchildren
Urusan, of the Nerek Owl Clan
The children demands Bugg’s blessing, despite being just an embalmer and not a Nerek
Unn, a hulking Nerek/Tarthenal cousin whom the Nerek children adore, enters the house to look upon their grandmother
Bugg knows it's over for Gerun Eberict
Selush of the Stinking House had twenty seven short braids wrapped around deer antlers and appeared between 35-50 years old
Used beach work ink to dye her eyes violet
Painted on a mildly toxic snake venom on her lips to make them swell and plump
Selush looks at Shurq close up and pinpoints the moment Shurq died
The last day if the summer Betrayer’s month, drowned in the Quillas Canal by the meatgrinder shop
For the beauty treatment, Selush uses cinnamon and patchouli for the perfume and an ootooloo

An ootooloo is parasitic creature that lives in the Bluerose Mountain hot springs that can be implanted on Shurq’s privates and restore her sensation for sexual pleasure as well as revitalizing her body
The ootooloo needs daily feeding
Selush also plans to infuse a poison, from an enemy of the ootooloo, into Shurq’s brain so it won’t grow roots into her brain and control her
Bugg returns home from blessing and burying the Nerek grandmother, an hour before dawn
Shand’s inside waiting impatiently for Tehol
Tehol is working on twelve lines of investments that are essential to the economy but also subtly destroy the economy unnoticed
The three ladies have been taking turns bedding Ublala Pung
Bugg’s Construction is expected to take an Eternal Domicile contract
Tehol tries to make small talk with Selush’s assistant, Padderunt that complains about his work
Padderunt takes him to a restaurant with grain cakes, and rustleaf tea that doubles your heart rate, vomit everything in your stomach, and used as an insecticide
Chapter 6 Scene 12 (Selush’s Stinking House,
Shurq Elalle)
Shurq looks at herself in the memory, body looking alive again and wearing new clothes
‘I look like a whore’
Her lungs were replaced by pumps filled with cinnamon and myrrh to scent her dead breath
Selush takes her to join Tehol and Padderunt at the local restaurant
Kuru Qan has two of his servants carry Brys from the Cedance to his office chambers. Later Nifadas, then King Diskanar enters
Ezgara Diskanar is in his 60’s, lean, prominent asymmetrical facial features due to an incident with a horse
Right cheekbone were flatter and higher making the eye look larger and rounder and sometimes wandered like lazy eye
Healers could've fixed his face but he was stubborn
Wore clothes of a commoner in a market
Nifadas leaves first to prepare for his departure from Letheras
Diskanar apologizes to Brys for putting him in danger
Also is aware of his wife Janall’s spies and that his son Quillas is a short tempered idiot that might not listen to anyone’s advice
Mentions that Gerun Eberict’s entourage needs reducing before leaving the chambers
Brys shares his adventures with Kuru Qan, that the Edur will no longer be able to enslave further demons
Kuru Qan remembers a joke he heard from the market witches that the world is ended by a kind word which scares Brys
Seren Pedac and the caravan have been waiting for five days in Hiroth for the Great Meeting to start
Thinks Hannan Mosag asserts his dominance by making the Letherii wait for him
Seren watches Edur children play among the blackwood surrounded by wraiths, which frightens her
All of the Edur tribes (Arapay, Merude, Beneda, Sollanta, and even the reclusive Den-Ratha) are present in Hiroth which shows their unity is real
The Nerek escorts are frightened and depressed that the Edur see right through them as if they were lesser beings and lose the will to eat
Seren tries to get Hull Beddict to help the Nerek, he says they’re waiting for the Edur to accept them
Seren walks into the inner ward to find an Edur matron to arrange an official welcome to the Nerek, she runs into Mayen
Mayen wears a midnight blue wool robe with gold-threaded patterns, long brown hair loose
Seren is surprised when she has to explain what the Nerek are to her, not thinking about it herself
To Seren, the Nerek are similar to the Edurs’ slaves, except they’re beholden by debt
Mayen agrees to grant the blessing of a welcome to the Nerrek and sends Feather Witch off to tell Uruth Sengar that she’ll be a bit late
Seren recognizes the name ‘Feather Witch’ as a very old name in history
Udinaas scales fish at the front door as Feather Witch approaches with the message for Uruth
Because FW is rude, Udinaas asks FW about her dreams but she denies it
Udinaas realizes FW is a tsundere because she feels indebted for saving her life from the wyval
FW does catch herself softening towards Udinaas
FW feels that Udinaas doesn’t speak like he used to
[Note: Udinaas has that “philosophical Erikson speak”. We can infer that the wyval blood, Wither, or any other of his recent experiences is affecting his personality]
Udinaas is shocked that Mayen is going to bless the Nerek, FW thinks Mayen has gotten a big head and acts if she’s queen
The Nerek are a broken people, their gods are dead and ancestral spirits scattered
An Edur blessing could possibly sanctify ground and draw some ancestral spirits depending on:
The purity of Mayen’s bloodline
Mayen’s destiny
If Mayen is still a virgin
FW admits she’s going to perform a Casting of the Tiles that night, walks over and waits away from Udinaas
Udinaas considers themselves ‘fallen’, among the ghosts at the feet of their conquerors that may one day kill their conquerors out of vengeance

Udinaas weeps, knowing only people that understood the emotion of ‘recognition’ can see the fallen - the people who are nobodies. Slaves, serfs, peasants, labourers, extras, background characters, NPC’s

Fallen. Who tracks our footsteps, I wonder? We who are the forgotten, the discounted and the ignored. When the path is failure, it is never willingly taken. The fallen. Why does my heart weep for them? Not them but us, for most assuredly I am counted among them. Slaves, serfs, nameless peasants and labour' ers, the blurred faces in the crowd – just a smear on memory, a scuffing of feet down the side passages of history.
Can one stop, can one turn and force one's eyes to pierce the gloom? And see the fallen? Can one ever see the fallen?
And if so, what emotion is born in that moment?
There were tears on his cheeks, dripping down onto his chafed hands. He knew the answer to that question, knife-sharp and driven deep, and the answer was ... recognition.
Seren Pedac and Hull Beddict discuss Mayen blessing the arrival of the Nerek which has stirred them again
However, Nerek now have a new [unspecified] fear
The Nerek have been here since the First Landing [probably of the First Empire], isn’t clear if the Edur or Nerek had lived on the continent first
Hull points out the Nerek were blessed before the Letherii possibly as an insult
Seren and Hull discuss the Nerek creation myth
Lizards [K’Chain Che’Malle] and dragons [eleint soletaken] and ice [Jaghut], a god-king betrayed [Silchas]
The Nerek believed they were born from a single mother [Eres, N’eres, Eres’al] that was a thief of fire [Note: Tellann?] and walked through time seeking an answer to a mysterious need
The single mother gave birth to a daughter that was the ancestor of the Nerek
The Nerek, in a confusing fashion, might believe several women could be the first mother
The Eres were ancestors to the Imass that were subordinate to the Deragoth in ancient Raraku
The Eres found holy sites where predators, like hyenas and leopards, were drawn to gather the remains of their prey
The T’lan Imass used these sites as gates between Tellann and the mortal realm
When Onrack activates an Eres bone pile between Tellann and the First Throne in Quon Tali, an Eres witch appears and rapes Trull, stealing his seed and leaving three slashes on his pelvic area
Fiddler’s squad mage Bottle had a grandmother that taught him about the Eres’al, the most ancient spirits of the physical world
Bottle sensed Eres’al spirits all around them in Raraku, that had changed the Tanno spiritwalker’s song to calm
The Kurald Emurlahn fragment of the Whirlwind was feeding on the souls of the ancient Eres’al
Udinaas and Feather Witch watch as Uruth Sengar and Mayen meet at the bridge, and walk towards the Sengar longhouse
Wither tells him that memories of a land can reshape themselves [similar to Raraku manifesting its memories of the past]
Wither shows Udinaas the land during the era of the KCCM vs. Tiste wars, and a KCCM skyleep floating over them
Forest of tall trees, violent waves upon the jagged black cliffs
Tall figures with proportionately small heads wearing furs
The vision’s scene abruptly changes to bedrock, roiling mists, and three figures:
Menandore, Sister Dawn
The figure of blinding light that raped Udinaas
Sukul Ankhadu, aka Dapple
Grey and black piebald skin, iron cuirass, chain vambraces, sealskin cloak
Sheltatha Lore, Daughter Dusk
Menandore and Sukul Ankhadu carried Shetaltha’s unconscious body and drops her to the ground
Menandore looks at Udinaas and is surprised to find him here

Mated with Scabandari and gave birth to Sheltatha Lore
Mated with Osseric and gave birth to Sukul Ankhadu and Menandore

Osseric doesn’t explain why
Menandore and Sukul plan on imprisoning Sheltatha Lore in the same Azath tower as Silchas Ruin
Osseric thinks it unwise to imprison two Soletaken eleint in one Azath tower

The Liosan sisters discuss Sheltatha Lore mating with the god Draconus to give birth to Lady Envy and Lady Spite

After some drama, the party became Envy, Rake, and Osseric
Caladan Brood disappeared for centuries and returned with Burn’s hammer
Before the Crippled God’s chaining, Rake and Envy had an argument and broke up

K’rul expected Envy to bring several hundred Seguleh, surprised she has only three top ranked Seguleh
K’rul reveals to Envy that the warrens are his veins, and that the Crippled God is poisoning him
Because Lady Envy wasn’t present at the Chaining of the Crippled God, she may be to blame for Hood kidnapping Dassem Ultor’s daughter to strike at the T’lan Imass
Lady Envy returns from Callows to her traveling party and they reach a Pannion-territory hamlet, introducing herself as Lady Islah’Dracon to the Seerdomin Kahlt in charge
At night the party slaughter the Pannions in the hamlet and continue traveling north
Envy recognizes the language used on a crossroads sign that the Pannion-territory used to be a Genostelian colony on Genabackis
Lady Envy’s party arrives at Bastion where they run into the Anaster leading the Tenescowri. Envy goes berserk when Toc the Younger abandons the party
Lady Envy’s party rampages through the Pannion territory to the city of Outlook and then takes a Meckros floating island to Coral

Not understanding Picker’s sarcasm in another battle, she watches as more Bridgeburners including Trotts die in front of them whom Envy could’ve easily saved
Lady Envy reunites with Rake after the battle to tell him her father Draconus is trying to escape Dragnipur
Rake banishes Envy from Black Coral (after the Tiste Andii plunged the city in Kurald Galain)
Envy escorts the remaining Seguleh home to their isle
Lady Envy is not in Midnight Tides, but thought it’d be nice to refresh. We also have not met Lady Spite yet, and won’t in Midnight Tides either.
Seren Pedac stands on the beach on the rain at night and pondered on the Letherii slaves
The slaves to the Edur had no debt and worked for food and shelter, could marry. Loss of freedom meant nothing to them
Ponders on Feather Witch casting tiles for her people without demanding payment
Udinaas walks up and puts his injured hands in the water
They talk about slavery, Udinaas accepted that he'll never be free
Seren asks about Feather Witch, her bloodline has been among the Edur for 20 generations and she’s going to cast the tiles that night
Udinaas walks back to the village
Seren Pedac joins Buruk and Hull Beddict by the Nerek’s camp fire while it's still raining
Buruk feels guilty for the crime of what's about to happen
Buruk had been Fear’s guest before, but none of the Sengar’s sons are here [Stone Bowl and wherever the hell Binadas wanders to]
The three walk on the Avenue of the Warlock through the inner ward to Hannan Mosag’s citadel
Inside the longhouse looked empty, the marks on the floor suggest the feast table was replaced with a smaller one
Hannan Mosag is already halfway into his meal, the K’risnan Cadre sits behind him
Hannan Mosag apologizes for eating without them and invites them in
Seren Pedac finds his voice smooth and easy to listen to for hours
Hannan Mosag offers Trate wine that he admits was acquired through violence
Buruk brings up the Letherii slaughter over the tusked seals and the empty ships that returned to Trate
Hull stands up and says the slaughter was justified, however Hannan Mosag retorts and grieves for the Indebted used as scapegoats for the Letherii
Seren Pedac claims herself neutral as Acquitor and showed Hull to join them because she thought she wouldn't be able to stop him
Hannan Mosag dismisses Seren but still would like to speak to her later
Seren leaves, thinking that Hannan Mosag actually wants peace and Hull won't accomplish his war
Udinaas chats with Hulad about Feather Witch’s Tile casting
Mayen was upset Uruth chastised her for blessing your Nerek, and so Mayen vented her frustration by beating Feather Witch with a stick
Feather Witch performed the casting surrounded by fellow slaves in a barn
Fulcra. Fire, Dolmen, Errant
Feather Witch pauses silently, Udinaas heads over to Seren Pedac watching at the side, who senses something is wrong and screams to stop her
FW continues with the Beast Hold, the Azath Hold, the Ice Hold, the Dragon Hold, and the Empty Hold
Udinaas jokes ‘She’s not slept well lately, you see’
Full second Tile casting notes here (contains spoilers)
Seren Pedac walks outside the barn into the rains and cries, thinking about the Edur children’s laughter earlier that day
The Sengar and Buhn brothers are traveling on Hannan Mosag’s mission to retrieve the gift he saw in his dreams. They have passed Arapay lands and now are at the ice fields
Trull looks at Theradas Buhn, who was blooded when he killed a Merude tribe Edur that had scarred Theradas’ right cheek, leaving a gaping hole into the skull between the right eye socket and jaw
Theradas wore a red tipped fox fur cloak
The Arapay warned the brothers of rhe Jheck, ‘standing wolves’ that were night hunters wielding jagged black iron blaces
The Jheck killed Edur, taking trophies and leaving behind limbless and headless torsos
Also, wooly mammoths frozen in the ice
Traveling formation
Theradas Buhn leads 15 paces ahead
Rhulad Sengar and Midik Buhn at the flanks, both wearing collared bear furs and fur-lined gauntlets
Fear, Binadas, and Trull are in the center pulling two sleds with leather satchels of their supplies
The party wore wool covering everything against the wind except their eyes, travelling slowly on the ice fields because of pockets of saltwater below making the ice thin
Trull remembers Letherii beliefs in the Holds, thinks specifically in the Hold of Ice
In Edur legends, ice was a thief of the Edur’s life, land, and righteous reward
[Gothos’ Omtose Phellack sorcery after he KCCM wars]
In the afternoon, the party reaches a crevasse in the ice field, 15 paces across, with the smell of tide pools at the bottom
Fear has them climb down to make camp
The bottom of the crevasse looked like a seabed, with pools inhabited by shrimps and barnacles, also has a greenish glow
Fear believes they are at the lowest point of the ancient sea bed, where the sea retreated until it fully evaporated leaving behind pillars of salt
The salt pillars may restart the cycle of melting the ice wastes into a saltwater lake that will evaporate, flood with freshwater, freeze into a frozen waste again
Fear remains at the camp with the unblooded Rhulad and Midik as the rest (Trull, Theradas, Binadas) go to investigate the signs of people who were here just days before them

A cavern wall revealed a pristine vista into hundreds of wildlife froze in time
Wolves hunting caribou
Some animals had thawed and fell out of the wall, decaying on the floor eaten by flies
Trull brings up the Hold of Ice
Binadas: ‘The Hand of the Watcher [Gothos] who waited until the war was done before striding forward to unleash his power’
Their Edur legends become vulnerable to challenges, but the evidence collapses to the ground to rot and eaten by flies
Binadas noticed the people who made the altar came from a different cavern than they did
The group return to Fear’s camp
The Hiroth warriors climb out of the crevasse and notice the lone tracks of a large wolf, similar to the wolf frozen in the dome
They travelled and stopped for a midday break, one day away from their destination of the Hannan Mosag’s gift, Trull is very suspicious of the circumstances around it
During Trull’s watch he sees shifting patterns in the sky [an aurora?] and wakes up Theradas for his watch
Trull sleeps and dreams of Mayen having sex with someone in a forest, Trull becomes lost trying to look for her
The Edur are slow to mature, marriage took a 10-20 years into adulthood
Edur women matured much faster than men and rumored to sleep with their Letherii slaves
Trull wakes up and is pissed to find Rhulad sleeping on his watch, jabs his face to wake him up
Rhulad vehemently denies falling asleep despite all their food supplies having been stolen
No tracks were left behind, but they know the Jheck were among them and could've killed them all in their sleep
The Hiroth warriors continued traveling, now paranoid, Rhulad’s shame will haunt him and the Sengar family forever among the other Edur families
The Hiroth warriors reach the colossal pristinely clear shard spar that look like it shot out from the earth, displacing wagon sized ice chunks
The warriors become alert, Binadas senses that Hannan Mosag’s summoned demon had been here
They find Hannan Mosag’s gift, a two handed mottled sword, bell hilted, blade fractured
As Trull argues his suspicions around the gift, Theradas alerts the part of wolves
Binadas weaves shadows into Trull’s blackwood spear, Trull felt the emotion of terror reverberating from the spear
Binadas implies that the wraiths are resisting his commands because they know they're going to die, the wraiths are not their ancestors [because the wraiths are Andii]

Trull attacks the spar containing the sword gift, wraiths from the snow and Trull’s spear leap at the mottled sword and the spar explodes into mist and the sword is released, sword point in the ground

Binadas gets dogpiled by Jheck, envelopes them in writhing shadows, and climbs free out of the mound of corpses
Rhulad disappears
Theradas and Midik Buhn slay a giant wolf

The Edur face off with the Jheck prepared to die until Rhulad descends on them with the mottled sword
Rhulad beheads one and chops at another
The Jheck rushes Rhulad, impaling him with spears and shoves him to the ground. Rhulad dies 💀
The Jheck then retreats in a panic
Trull doesn't understand why the Jheck retreated when they basically won
The Buhn brothers both return, neither are seriously wounded
Trull and Fear try to take the mottled sword but can’t take it out of Rhulad’s dead grasp
Binadas reminds them that Hannan Mosag warned not to touch the gift
Fear decides to being Rhulad and sword home together, it’s up to Hannan Mosag to deal with it
Rhulad is to return home as a hero
Trull felt Rhulad’s decisions leading up to his death was senseless, but still feels guilty that he thought Rhulad abandoned them when he died being brave
Fear saw that Rhulad killed two other Jheck on the other side of the spar and lost his weapon, which is why he picked up the mottled sword
Binadas’s left hip is broken and can’t walk, uses Emurlahn to heal everyone’s injuries
Midik cries for the death of his friend
New formation:
Midik leads ahead
Fear and Theradas pulls the sleds carrying Rhulad and Binadas
Trull watches their rear
The Hiroth warriors traveled at night, Trull trailed behind the sleds until he absent mindedly got lost
Trull’s mind dulls from a feverish nightmare
A full day passes without Trull realizing it, night already approaches, Trull grows numb to pain and feels warmth that grows into searing hot pain
Trull is blinded by the white around him
Trull senses the Jheck, slams a sword into the ground, breaks his spear thrusting and killing a first wolf 💀
Pulls the longsword to kill a second wolf 💀
Three Jheck watched from afar and disappear into the white background
Trulls hears footsteps and attacks the Jheck rushing him
Slashes the upper head off one Jheck 💀
Stabs a second Jheck through the ribs 💀
Pirouettes like Geralt and slashes the throat of a third Jheck 💀
Trull continues marching mindlessly, defending himself against countless Jheck ambushes 💀
, ready to die until he hears and sees the other Hiroth warriors run to him
Trull wakes up on the sled next to Binadas and Rhulad’s wrapped up body
Fear and Binadas are cooking meat, the Hiroth warriors have made it past the ice fields
Binadas made sorcerous contact with the Arapay Edur tribe who are on their way
Fear told Trull that he split off, diverted the Jheck away from the sleds
Trull wonders why they didn't bring 500 Edur, so the Jheck would've left them alone and not have a significant number of them die
Midik points over to the dozen wooly mammoths in the distance
Trull wishes they all had died
Withal greets Rhulad Sengar on the beach and they watch the Nachts Rind and Mape destroy Pule’s nest
Withal brings Rhulad to the Crippled God who explains his view on peace
Peace is a dulling of the senses
Praising virtues of honour, sacrifice, and loyalty to extremity
People grow restless and pursue threats, real or imagined, and war becomes inevitable
Old veterans return to familiar times, youth will experience the glories of those veterans, the king distracts his citizens from domestic affairs, and merchants enjoy a boon of wealth
The Crippled God asks for Withal’s opinion, Withal says his experience is actually the opposite which the Cripple God is unsatisfied with and hand waves
The Crippled God feels betrayed by Hannan Mosag who accepted his offer of power but does not pursue conquest. Instead Hannan Mosag just wanted power to defend his people
[Note: So Hannan Mosag might be a good guy]
The Crippled God conjures the mottled sword and tosses it at Rhulad’s feet, offering him power for his death
Withal sees ambition in Rhulad’s eyes and feels anguish as Rhulad takes the sword
Two days passed since Hannan Mosag spoke to Seren, Hull Beddict, and Buruk the Pale
Four days until the Letherii delegation arrive
It’s still raining as heavy as ever
Buruk became happy because he did not want a war despite merchants profiting off strife
Hull retreated to the forest to think on how he wants to achieve war within the Letherii
Seren, Buruk, and three Nerek carry silver ingots to the Edur guild house to trade
However, the Sengar and Buhn brothers arrive home and they go to the inner ward to witness
Seren Pedac and Buruk enter the inner ward and see Tomad and Uruth stand around the body
Buruk had heard that Tomad Sengar had rivaled Hannan Mosag for the Edur throne
Udinaas stood behind Uruth and was not surprised Rhulad died, didn’t look forward to dressing his corpse with enough gold Letherii coins ‘to ransom a prince’
Uruth orders Udinaas to dress the body and even says she's pleased to have such a diligent slave in her household
Udinaas knew she'd immediately kill him if she knew about the wyval blood in him
Hannan Mosag is furious they touched the mottled sword and would even cut Rhulad’s hand off
Binadas clarifies their circumstances of fighting the Jheck, who were Soletaken that were after the sword
Uruth denies Hannan Mosag the right to mutilate her son
Trull speaks the voice of reason to reach a compromise, which is to wait and see if Rhulad’s body thaws and releases the sword
Trull orders Udinaas to take Rhulad to the House of the Dead and not to expect the widows to attend the ritual
Udinaas gathers Hulad and one other and they do as he says
Seren Pedac pulls Buruk back to the merchant camps
Also starts having a crush on Trull, always liked the damaged ones
The situation has completely changed for when the delegation arrives for the Great Meeting
Udinaas, Hulad, and Irim take Rhulad to the House of the Dead where the coals were burning and ready
Rhulad’s body was encased in ice, expression as if screaming
Irim jokes about robbing the barrows and hiring a mage to dispel the wards and wraiths
Udinaas doesn’t dream of gold, only Feather Witch
Udinaas sends them away to inform Uruth that he begins
Trull sat in front of the Sengar longhouse sword
Thought Hannan Mosag was stupid and could've handled the situation better and now may lose his authority over the Edur for it
The acquitor and merchant who witnessed it may report back to the Letherii delegation and tipping the balance of the negotiation
Trull felt grief and guilt, thought back to the event that started everything when he killed a Letherii for hunting their tusked seals
Trull is shocked numb by grief and fear of the future
Udinaas packed Rhulad’s nostrils and ears with wax, and Rhulad’s wounds with clay and oil
Rhulad’s body thawed and water melted from the heat
163 Letherii gold coins to cover Rhulad’s body
Udinaas laid wax on the body and turned him over
The only other time Udinaas performed this task without widows assisting him was when he dressed Uruth’s father who died battling the Arapay tribe
Fear comes to Trull in their home
Hannan Mosag believes they failed and betrayed him
Hannan Mosag and their parents now speak privately in the citadel
The Arapay healers have taken to heal Binadas
Healing a mage is more difficult and will take several days
Trull thinks on the Jheck, the Edur believed Soletaken was a gift from Father Shadow and wonders why Jheck savages possessed the ability
Fear admits to feeling helpless, Trull empathizes and they are able to somewhat comfort each other
Trull walks to his bed, thinking of the fevered nightmare he experienced back then, and falls asleep
Udinaas completed dressing Rhulad’s backside with wax and coins, he turns him over to his front
The sword made his arm fall and ruin the wax casing around it
When Udinaas walks to the cauldron of wax, he hears the wax crack, turns to see the wax fell away from Rhulad’s neck, sees his head snap back and scream

cards.h: Scene 11 (House of the Dead, Trull Sengar)

i.html: Trull has a nightmare of being attacked by the Jheck wolves in a snowy landscape and wakes up to Rhulad’s screaming
Fear, Trull, Mayen, Feather Witch, Seren Pedac, Buruk the Pale, and other Edur gather around the House of the Dead
Fear and Trull enter the House alone, seeing Rhulad hug himself in a fetal position faced down, ever shrieking
Udinaas attempts to give soothing words to Rhulad which stops his shrieking, Rhulad begins to weep
Udinaas takes Rhulad's head and holds him in a motherly way
Fear sobs at the sight of Rhulad’s face
Udinaas took his knife and pried off the coins fixed to Rhulad’s eyes, while whispering soothing words to ‘keep insanity at bay’ and ‘guiding him back to the living’
Trull thinks how a Letherii slave is achieving this and how could they have done this to them
Udinaas is exhausted and blacks out between sentences, but Rhulad holds onto him and Trull asks he stay for a few moments longer
Rhulad has difficulty breathing from the wax and coins against his chest and abdomen
Rhulad says he wants Udinaas
Udinaas climbs over to lean against the chest of coins, feeling anguish over what Rhulad just said
Trull feels empathy for Udinaas
Trull looks out to the door, Mayen and Feather Witch stands there
Feather Witch sees Udinaas and runs away
Tomad, Uruth, and Hannan Mosag approaches
An unseasonal rain storm hits Letheras
Tehol tossed a hat into the hearthfire that Bugg made out of straw used to wrap raw fish
Ubalala weeps because the three women are taking turns having sex with him when Ubalala just wants to fall in love
Tehol dons the hat from the hearthfire, Tehol and Bugg leave to find Shurq Elalle in the Temple brothel that even Queen Janall visits throughout the year
Tehol and Bugg pass by a respectful executioner on the way in and are held at knife point by Matron Delisp before she directs them to Shurq
Matron Delisp is happy to get rid of Shurq because her other girls are furious that she’s taking all the clients
Tehol and Bugg are exhausted walking up the stairs to the top floor where Shurq Elalle is
Tehol proposes Ublala who wants a commitment to follow through with her orders and Shurq considers it
Shurq agrees with Matron Delisp for 60% of her earnings to be sent to Tehol's Rooftop
They leave
Shurq splits off, agreeing to meet Ubalala on Tehol’s roof at midnight
Bugg’s Construction’s project is on schedule and goes to prepare banana leaves for dinner at home
Tehol walks to the Azath tower looking for Kettle
A square tower with ‘strange triangular windows crowded with dead vines. The inset, black-stained wooden door was shrouded in shadow’
Kettle says there’s a man that tries to paint the tower and herself, but she hides from him by going behind a tree
Kettle thinks she'll like Tehol and asks if he can be her Father
The Azath tower communicates feelings to her. There’s someone she considers her uncle that can help, but there’s also bad ones that’ll destroy everything else
Kettle asks if Tehol ever dreams of dragons
Kettle says she needs to go kill someone and considers the artist
Brys Beddict trains the king’s guard when he noticed Turudal Brizad observing them and thought about his lazy ways
Letheras used to mandate four year military service for males that turned 17
Letheras had many enemies back then:
Bluerose that now pays tribute to King Diskanar
Independent city-states of the Dracons Sea archipelago that was crushed and now only remain farmers
Kolanse that’s now isolated after going through a civil war
Brys is bitter that the Letherii military was so tied to economics and only used when there was profit to be made
After the training ended, Brys was proud that his men stayed for further practice
The two people that left were known to be spies of Queen Janall
Turudal Brizad approaches Brys and says Chancellor Triban Gnol would like to speak to him

Strangely enough, Brizad echoes the Crippled God’s view that ‘peace leads to an indulgence in strife’ and that ‘life is characterized as an oscillation between strife during peace and strife during war’
‘In our soul burns a lust for discord’
Brizad also suggests a new feud between the Chancellor and the Ceda, Kuru Qan
Brys totally opposes Brizad’s view and he leaves
Kolanse far tf → across the desert
While walking, Brys thinks on several things
Nature vs nurture
How the martial world simplified Brys’ decision making by a might makes right mentality
How Turudal Brizad’s life must have more uncertainty because his life hinged on his beauty that will inevitably fade
Both Queen Janall and Chancellor Triban Gnol were rumored to be in love with Brizad
Brys returns to his room to change outfits
He notices misplaced knives, a signal from a spy that someone has been in his room which has been happening more frequently lately
Brys Beddict enters Kuru Qan’s chambers to find him hanging by a harness and wearing a helmet with lenses
The world has already been circumnavigated by early colonizers of the First Empire physically proving the world is round, Kuru Qan wants to discover the same truth theoretically
Kuru Qan sent his assistants away to order more lenses and has been hanging all day, hallucinating from dizziness, and on the verge of understanding the existence of gravity
Also hints that the Malazan world has four moons, one visible and the other three that are too small or distant hidden by the sun’s light
Also theorizes the Malazan world’s pangaea supercontinent
‘Who forwarded the Chancellor’s request?’ ‘What? Oh, Turudal Brizad.’ ‘Ah, yes. Such an errant, troubled lad. One sees such sorrow in his eyes, or at least in his demeanor.’
Brys unstraps Kuru Qan before he passes out or loses his limbs from lack of blood circulation

cards.h: Scene 7 (Chancellor Triban Gnol’s chambers, Brys Beddict)

i.html: Brys Beddict meets with Chancellor Triban Gnol and notes the candles scented with Kolanse spices, calls his chamber ‘a temple of gold coins, and [Triban Gnol] is the high priest’
Triban Gnol asks Brys if he feels the Letherii military is reliable and ready, Brys affirms
Triban Gnol also asks if he is married and has concerns over his brother Hull Beddict
Brys says it's none of his business, Triban Gnol says fine he won't care about Brys anymore, and Brys leaves
Brys Beddict is upset that he learned nothing of the new feud between the Triban Gnol and the Kuru Qan
Brys is sad that he had neither Hull’s determination or Tehol’s cunning, only skill with his sword
He decides to ask Tehol for help, who he thinks has no desires or ambitions at all
Tehol Beddict is distraught that their dinner is boiled banana leaves
Shand, Hejun, and Rissarh storm in about to beat up Tehol for doing nothing and wasting their time
Tehol disarms them by giving them a very long list of names and enterprises for them to buy shares in, aiming for 49% to get prepare for an ambush of controlling interest
Tehol has raised a peak from his investments using the 30,000 thirds the ladies had given him (that they wanted turned into 10 peaks to crash Letheras’ economy)
The ladies are somewhat satisfied and leave
Bugg noticed Rissarh had a knife tucked, and the only weapons they have are wooden spoons
Ublala Pung lies face down on the roof as Tehol introduces him and Shurq Elalle to each other
Tehol comically fails at turning Ublala over
Shurq asks Ublala what he saw on the bottom of Quillas Canal when he walked it
The canal is 7 man heights deep, but corpses and trash littered in the canal let Ublala stand and almost touch the surface
Shurq plans to carry out robbing Gerun Eberict's estate and wants Ublala to create a diversion, tells him the guards don't like him
Shurq wants to jump over the roofs but doesn't think Ublala can do it quietly
Ublala tries to prove her wrong
Brys Beddict leaves the palace toward’s Tehol’s home
Brys travels through the maze of the streets, seeing an increasing population of ‘the lost’, people who have given up on life and suffer as a result of Letheras’s rampant greed
The lower classes and impoverished were increasingly joining the Letherii military for dreams of wealth and glory, but have no love for the empire they serve
Brys wonders what happens when this populations becomes enraged, and would the military actually defend the empire they serve
Brys joins Tehol and Bugg on the roof and watch one of their neighbors have a domestic dispute
Tehol explains Ublala jumped the roofs, but it collapsed under his weight and now the neighbor is throwing stuff at him
Brys asks Tehol advice about his involvement in court politics
Tehol lists of the factions of King Diskanar and Queen Janall
Tehol suggests Brys stay silent and pretend to be the smartest and most all knowing one in the room
Brys and Tehol talk about their brother Hull Beddict
Tehol thinks Hull will try to destroy Letheras be killed before he does
Brys is expected to stay loyal to the King and not enact vengeance
Tehol, however, will avenge Hull without question which makes Brys feel better
Before Brys leaves, Tehol wants Brys to go to the palace information keepers and inquire about the annual numbers of people missing in Letheras
Shurq Elalle watches Ublala run around finding estate guards to beat him, distracting them from Shurq breaking into Gerun Eberict’s estate
Shurq is distracted by the ootooloo’s hunger
Shurq passes through the first layer of wards meant to detect living beings and climbs over iron spikes at the top of the wall
Ublala knocks down the gates and beats up everyone he sees, angry because he thinks they hate him because Shurq told him that earlier
Shurq walks through the front door into a reception hall that had a fresco painting of Gerun Eberict saving King Diskanar’s life, she carved a mustache on him
Continues into a mock throne room chamber with a long table (probably his dining room)
She enters the indebted servants quarters scaring the bejeezus out of them wondering where to go next
A servant Prist asks out loud who it was outside, Shurq goes to his quarters and has sex with him
Two hours pass, Ublala escapes and things settle down
Shurq assumes Gerun Eberict has an office and walks upstairs to search the second floor
Shurq disarms two tripwires ino the servants’ hall
Harlest Eberict, another undead similar to Shurq, is surprised that Shurq looks so alive and makes a deal to help her in exchange for breaking them out

Harlest likes the idea of filing his teeth into fangs and nails into talons, to look more monstrous [what a quirky guy]
Gerun seems to keep his servants working for him even in undeath, dunno where the money comes from
Shurq and Harlest enter Gerun’s office and take all his diamonds and writs of holding, including the ones in his safe he seems to hold for an imminent transaction
Harlest agrees to escape with Shurq through the balcony
The Azath grounds steams as Kettle feeds a tree a body
The bad ones underground were hunting the weak, and were going to escape soon
Kettle's 'friend' was trapped under the oldest tree and couldn't go any further, help was on the way but won't make it on time
It was becoming more difficult for Kettle to find spies, criminals, and other bad people to kill and feed the trees
The Azath tower is dead
Udinaas sits on a tree trunk watching the sea and tides
Heartbroken that Feather Witch ran away from him at the House of the Dead
Udinaas passed out in the House of the Dead and had to be carried out to his bed
Udinaas thinks the situation may be different if the mottled sword claimed any other brother, but it chose the unstable one eager for war
Udinaas wished he let Rhulad become insane, because he now claimed him as his slave
Seren Pedac sips tea with Buruk the Pale
The Edur gather at the citadel
Feather Witch is casting tiles at a more discrete location
Hull Beddict is still in the woods, possibly exploring ruins with artifacts to the northeast
Buruk thinks the mottled blade came from Sukul Ankhadu, the dappled Edur figure [that's actually a Tiste Liosan]
Seren remarked that the Edur fear Sukul Ankhadu, but worship Father Shadow and his daughter Sheltatha Lore
Seren appears listless, Buruk thinks Seren is a sensitive person and that if Hull Beddict dies, Seren would blame herself
Seren doesn't reply [because he's right]
Trull and the Edur wait in silence and anxiety, for Rhulad to hand over the sword and complete their mission to Hannan Mosag or leave the Sengar brothers in dishonor
Suddenly, Rhulad stands straight up unburdened by the gold weight
Rhulad claims the sword for himself, reveals Hannan Mosag intended to betray the new ally he made a pact with, and demand they all kneel before him
Rhulad shrieks at his brother Binadas to come to him and slashes his fingers across his chest, healing the pain from Binadas’s fractured hip
Rhulad claims Hannan Mosag had united the pathetic six Edur tribes, but now it’s Rhulad who will lead them to become an empire
Fear wonders how and why Rhulad has come back
Rhulad reveals the shadow wraiths are Tiste Andii, Edur ancestors have never been present and did not belong here
Rhulad vows he will lead the Edur home
Fear kneels and pledges himself to Emperor Rhulad
Trull witnesses the rest of the Edur including Hannan Mosag kneel before Rhulad, and notes it sounds like a spine breaking
Udinaas wants to throw himself into the sea and drift as a corpse
The Locqui Wyval grabs Udinaas and tosses him inland, denying him the chance to kill himself
Udinaas thinks Hannan Mosag should killed Rhulad because Rhulad is a monster
Hulad comes, says Feather Witch failed to cast the tiles because the Holds were closed to her, she's panicking
Only the noble Edur attended the meeting at the citadel
Hulad notices the bruises from the Locqui Wyval on Udinaas’s shoulders
Udinaas returns to his bed at the Sengar longhouse

Seren and Buruk watch the Letherii delegation arrive on the beach
Seren doesn't know who to acknowledge first, Buruk says the one who’s most likely to be offended, Seren jokes she could probably look at the space between
Prince Quillas is carried over the watch by his servants, Nifadas simply wades in the water without any assistance
Finadd and the Prince’s Guard Moroch Nevath speaks to Seren and Buruk first
Prince Quillas immediately asks where Hull Beddict is
Seren and Buruk report the situation about the Sengar brothers’ mission and Rhulad’s resurrection

[Note: Withal forged it in the prologue]

Nifadas left most of his guard on the Risen Pale ship including Finadd Gerun Eberict
Seren reports of the meeting between Hannan Mosag, Hull, and Buruk but doesn't know the details
Nifadas claims there is no neutrality anymore and that she needs to pick a side
Seren thinks Rhulad won't give the sword to Hannan Mosag, and that his brother Binadas is blood-sworn to Hull
Seren has already chose sides
