Wither tempts him that he can take Feather Witch for his own
The Locqui Wyval agrees with Wither
Wither [out of nowhere] wonders why Menandore raped him and what her plans are
Udinaas outs on his shoes and walks to the citadel in the rain
Hulad is outside, worried that Udinaas is talking to himself
Udinaas arrives, witnessing the Edur kneel before Rhulad
Udinaas lied that he heard Rhulad’s summons and reports of the Letherii delegation’s arrival
Rhulad orders him to retrieve them and allows him to turn around and show him his back, no longer a sign of disrespect
Udinaas goes to the merchant camps and beckons them
A guard demands Udinaas show respect to his prince, Udinaas retorts his master is Tiste Edur
Udinaas leads the delegation to the citadel and the shadow wraiths block their path implying their demand to leave the guards outside
Udinaas tells them that the Edur including Hannan Mosag has pledged themselves to Emperor Rhulad
Udinaas, Seren, Nifadas, and Prince Quillas enter the citadel
Udinaas looked at the Edur people and is shocked for the first time. There are a fallen people. Who would rise anew.
Emperor Rhulad greets the Letherii delegation and asks the value of a treaty if their previous one was broken. He has Hannan Mosag speak on this matter
The Letherii (Prince Quillas/Nifadas) claims the Edur owe a debt to the Letherii for the value of the [illegally] harvested tusked seals

Hannan Mosag claims the Edur did not confiscate the seals, thus instead the Letherii are in debt to the Edur
Prince Quillas claims they brought gifts, but Hannan Mosag rejects them knowing the tactic of charging interest leaving them vulnerable to conquest
The Letherii delegation retires to their camps to reconvene and discuss
Trull watched Hannan Mosag speak calmly to Rhulad, as if for the sake of the Edur
Udinaas escorts the Letherii to their camps and comes back to the citadel
Rhulad asks [demands] Fear gift Mayen to him and make her Empress
Trull steps forward in objection, Rhulad shrieks that he'll flay Trull alive
Fear accepts
Mayen walks forward and takes Rhulad’s hand, an expression of horror on her face
With this the Edur and Fear know now that Mayen never cheated or betray him with Rhulad
Trull believes the fate of the Edur rests on someone outside to rescue them from Rhulad
Seren Pedac waits outside in the rain for Udinaas
Udinaas tells her Rhulad has taken Mayen and that the Letherii must prepare for war

All That Lies Unseen
Tehol Beddict explains five wings of the palace earns a grovel at the feet of the Errant, of destiny

Tehol has a safe house for Shurq Elalle and her new friend Harlest Eberict
Tehol wants to meet with the leaders of the Rat Catcher’s Guild to contract them for something

6,921 people have disappeared in Letheras in the past year with an additional possible 3,460 and a half
The palace contracted the Rat Catcher’s Guild to investigate the disappearances
Brys leaves, frightened of the scale Tehol is working with and would rather be blissfully ignorant
Brys goes to the training grounds for comfort
Bugg visits Shurq Elalle and Harlest Eberict in their safehouse which is actually a Jaghut tomb
Forkrul Assail hieroglyphics of curses are scribed on the walls
The Errant seems to have had some hand in creating the Tiles, the Forkrul Assail is a Fulcra piece
Wards were meant to defend against the T’lan Imass
The Jaghut chose to leave their bodies behind for their souls to travel the Hold of Ice
Shurq gives over the diamonds to Bugg and wants Ublala
Harlest is obsessed on be a spooky zombie monster,  has been practicing his hissing and snarling noises
Bugg leaves the Jaghut tomb to the next Bugg’s Construction project
An abandoned boarding school, that had collapsed killing a third of its students, into a wealthy mansion

Fear orders B’nagga to send half the Jheck to watch the Letherii unseen, and to leave a dozen wraiths to make the Letherii think only a few are left
B’nagga leaves
Trull fears the power of the mage cadre, the K’risnan says their magic is equal because their power is linked to Hannan Mosag to Rhulad himself
Fear snaps at Trull to stop and orders Trull to lead 50 Hiroth warriors to the bridge [at Katter River] and wait for Hanradi Khalag’s men. If the Letherii are their, only skirmish at most
Trull leaves
Trull feels himself being reactionary and blindly following orders like the Edur around him no matter how much he opposes or resists, fearing isolation and lost of trust
Trull approaches the Hiroth men he assembled, whom don’t like Trull for his open opposition to the war
Trull approaches Ahlrada Ahn, the captain he assigned who also hates Trull
Left handed, wields a Merude cutlass with a bell-hilt and quillons that catches enemy weapons
Trull orders that they will be traveling off-trail to reach the bridge first
Sergeant Canath argued with Trull that it’ll be too slow but relents
Trull’s squads depart at a steady running pace, take a mid-morning break, then the squads split up entering the forests off-trail
Trull followed Canath’s squad, Canath ignored him and pretended he wasn’t there
The leading squad halts, making everyone else halt
A Faraed scout was seen, Trull orders a single warrior to walk on the main road [as a distraction?]
Trull plans to have the 15 Edur around him lay a trap behind the Faraed scout
Since the squads split up in the forest, Trull has no way of communicating with half of his warriors
Trull’s men wait in anticipation, the Faraed attempts to flee but is killed by a spear into his back snapping his spine
The Faraed was a 14-15 year old child, Trull is the only one that feels remorse

The Katter River bridge is actually a disc, the rim being 8 Edur wide. The hub center was three Edur-heights down with stone spokes. The rim was notched, the bottom of disc was shrouded in darkness and river mist
The Narrow Chute Gorge seemed to have notches meant to fit the wheel, and the wheel turned extremely slowly
Trull’s squads crossed the bridge, Ahlrada Ahn felt movement on the smooth stone panel he stood on. Brushing it revealed arcane symbols carved on it
Ahlrada used to live and hunt with the isolated Den-Ratha tribe Edur. They had come across an iceberg that sank into the sea that had the same kind of carvings
The Tusked Man, grey-green skin, seen occasionally over generations
[Speculation: This may be Icarium, and the wheel bridge being one of his time-measuring mechanisms]
Canarth finds a rotting dead owl further up the trail
Wither’s memories and knowledge of the First Empire flowed through Udinaas’s mind
The First Empire charted 6 continents and 811 islands, establishing colonies on all
Found other non-human races: Tartheno, Fenn, Mare, Jhag, Krinn, Jheck
‘The Emperor who was One was now Seven, and the Seven were scattered, lost in madness’
T’lan Imass were responsible for the end of the First Empire
Udinaas sits on a slope above the Edur encampment looking over it
Rhulad was tired and frustrated over arguments of army logistics with Hannan Mosag
Udinaas begins to think neither Wither nor the Wyval were real because none of the powerful beings around him sensed those two inside Udinaas
The Wyval blood possibly infected Udinaas after he was raped by Menandore, a Tiste Liosan eleint soletaken
Udinaas thinks he started going mad when he realized he would never be with Feather Witch whom he was in love with
Feather Witch serendipitously appears, demanding he take her to the dream realm where she found him
Feather Witch takes Udinaas’s hands and presses on the Fulcra Fire tile, surrounding them in fire, pushed them into a dream world
Udinaas and Feather Witch are pinned down by what’s later revealed to be mortal Bentract Imass
Short muscular man, honey colored skin, overlong arms, long loose black hair, heavy face features, dark eyes, shelf-brow, cloak fur. Scarred face, firearms that healed badly from being broke
After some moments, the T’lan Imass let them go
Udinaas and Feather Witch are in a three-walled basin, where the Imass lived in fissures in the walls
The fourth side was open to a view of a shattered city, broken timber, cobbled streets, and chunks of ice with chunks of rotting K’Chain Che’Malle
Udinaas simply walked towards the city and recognizes the city is Meckros from the water-proof wood and remnants of docks
Feather Witch sees hundreds of fresh mounds able to hold hundreds of bodies
The dead’s weapons and treasures were left on the surface
Udinaas thinks the Imass buried the dead Meckros inhabitants
Udinaas realizes the T’lan Imass are living as ghostly memories which is why they’re flesh and blood
Feather Witch realizes that several tiles of the Beast Hold were stolen from the Eres’al
The Bone Perch, Elder, Crone, Seer, Shaman, Hunter, Tracker. Stealers of Fire
Round, dark squat savages wearing skins of beasts were carved in the tiles
Feather Witch admits to seeing Menandore rape Udinaas
She summoned the wyval for its blood and obtain freedom, she’s angry that Udinaas received it instead
Udinass thinks the wyval chose him because he wasn’t dreaming of freedom
Udinaas and Feather Witch return to the Imass
Four Imass women appeared with a boy who could speak the Imass and the Letherii languages
Rud Elalle, ‘rud’ meaning found in the trader language
Udinaas also knows the trader language and they are able to communicate better
Rud Elalle tells them the story of how he survived the Meckros city crash
His father, Araq Elalle, and his mother were both Letherii Indebted that escaped to the Meckros city where they lived in freedom
Rud Elalle was playing in the cobbled streets when the city was being torn apart by ice

The boy bumped into Menandore’s legs, she picked him up and flew in the air, swearing the whole time, saying she worked hard on this beget and won't let ‘the legless bastard’ [Note: Crippled God] ruin her plans
Rud Elalle is only 7 weeks old
[Note: At this point you can guess Rud Elalle is the son between Menandore and Udinaas]
The Bentract Imass, Ulshun Pral, asks through Rud Elalle if the boy will eat the women when he is older and what dragons eat
The Bentract Imass promised Menandore to take care of the boy until she returns
Ulshun Pral thinks Udinaas is the father, but Rud Elalle thinks it's someone named Araq Elalle
Ulshun Pral offers to take them to the gates of this world
Ulshun Pral leads Udinaas, Feather Witch, and Rud Elalle deep into one of the caverns in the three-walled basin
Through caves of red and yellow ochre depicting ancient beasts standing, running, and dying from spears. Also black stick figures of Imass

The caverns led to an open clearing of bedrock, with boulders leading into a spiral where a Bentract Bonecaster sacrificed herself to seal the wound that was a realm of storms/beast and transformed into a petrified cairn of flat stones
A twelve sided squat tower of crystals that reflected colours that spiralled into a dark hole
Ulshun Pral reveals they are in Starvald Demelain
Lists of eleint which is the best way he can describe the warren

T’iam [Elder Goddess of the Eleint], Kalse, Silanah (Companion to Anomander Rake), Ampelas, Okaros, Karosis. Sorrit. Atrahal, Eloth, Anthras. Kessobahn, Alkend, Karatallid, Korbas [possible unconfirmed reference to Korabas the Otataral Dragon], Olar [Unconfirmed possible reference to Olar Ethil the First Soletaken of the Imass]
Soletaken eleint had gathered here
Draconus,  K’rul, Anomandaris, Osserc, Silchas Ruin, Scabandari, Sheltatha Lore, Sukul Ankhadu,Menandore
Ulshun Pral they can pass through the gate, and looks forward to treating them to a feast when they return
Udinaas and Feather Witch bids Ulshun Pral and Rud Elalle as they leave through the gate
Atri-Preda Yan Tovis, aka Twilight, stands with a local Finadd on the north coast of Fent Reach watching the Edur sail to begin their invasion
800-900 raider ships and 400 transport ships carry about 300,000 Edur
The shadow of the enslaved demon spirit-god swimming beneath them
First Maiden Fort is retreating its people this morning to Fent Reach
Yan Tovis has three mages, one’s always drunk and the other two want to kill each other
A third Edur fleet appeared in the Katter Sea
Atri-Preda Yan Tovis is surrendering Fent Reach
Preda Commander of the Army
Atri-Preda Commander of a City
Ceda High Mage
Atri-Ceda Commander of the mages
Finadd Captain

cards.h: Scene 1 (Slope over the Edur encampment, Udinaas)

i.html: Udinaas wakes up on the edge of the slope he was sitting on looking over the Edur encampment
Feather Witch was also next to him with the broken Fulcra Fire tile under her hand
Udinaas sees the Edur mobilizing and says they should join them
Feather Witch doesn't want to now that she's tasted freedom
Feather Witch admits the Rhulad verbally abuses Mayen, in turn Mayen physically abuses and beats Feather Witch
Eventually Feather Witch takes Udinaas’s hands and they descend the slope
Late afternoon, Trull and his fifty Edur warriors watch as the Letherii soldiers approach uphill closer to the Katter Bridge
The Letherii mages detected the presence of the Edur
Wolves appeared and veered, with a spicy scent, into their humanoid Jheck forms
B’nagga reports to Trull that they found the dead of the boy scout that Trull had killed, whom may have been linked to the Letherii mages
Also reports that First Maiden Fort retreated to Fent Reach
Rhulad’s forces are also undetected north of Trate
They predict there will be four major battles
Seren Pedac is drunk as hell in a bar in commotion about the impending Letherii-Edur war
Iron Bars, a blue-eyed Crimson Guard soldier that landed in Letheras from Assail, offers to take Seren away from the Empire
Second Blade, Fourth Company in service to Commander Cal-Brinn
The Crimson Guard saw the enslaved demon spirit-god swimming underneath the Edur ships
Iron Bars tells her the plan to get a ship in Letheras to sail home, warns to leave Trate asap, Seren is welcome to join them
Iron Bars leaves
Nekal Bara, the Letherii sorcerer in blue silks, stands atop a lighthouse looking out to sea
They knew their sorcerous attack had struck empty villages
As soon as Yan Tovis surrendered Fent Reach, the Edur immediately began sailing towards Trate with their enslaved demon spirit-god
Trate Harbor used to be a limestone shelf with underground rivers. The limestone shelf collapsed into deep circular wells
One circular well became a place of worship, where gold, silver, jade, and living sacrifices were offered
A spirit was either drawn or manifested to feed off the blood and grief of the unwilling sacrifices
Eventually the worshipers died out and had competition among other worshipped spirits along the shoreline, that the spirit should've died
The Edur found a way to feed it and enslave it
Arahathan, the second Letherii mage, stood on the main pier, planning to face the Edur’s enslaved demon spirit-god and keep it busy so that Nekal Bara could strike at its heart
Enedictal, the third Letherii mage, returned to the Snakebelt Battalion in Awl
The enslaved demon spirit-god surges into Trate Harbor
A trebuchet fires a ball of flaming pitch that uselessly snuffs out in the water
Arahathan roars, causing a line of water to boil and erect a steam wall against the enslaved demon spirit-god
The impact creates a shockwave that topples the lighthouse Nekal Bara stands on
Arahathan is swallowed by the enslaved demon spirit-god
Nekala Bara leaps from the falling lighthouse balcony and casts threads of blue fire that swarms around a blinding white core into a spear that impales enslaved god’s flank
Nekal Bara sees Arahathan’s flesh sear off his body, teeth showing through missing lips and a maddening smile, eyes collapsed inward. Arahathan dies.
The enslaved demon spirit-god reveals its physical form of blood, matted hair, and bone covered by layers of jewelry, gold coins, and the corpses of newborns with its foreheads caved in
[Note: The offering the sea gods were given when it was worshiped in the past]
Nekal Bara is mortified by the haunting monster in front of her. Nekal Bara imminently dies
Seren woke up in the dark cellar of the tavern after having been raped, her armor, weapons, and possessions stolen, and staggers out into the street with Trate in panic over the Edur attack

Seren watches a man punch and cave in another man’s skull, women screaming from being discovered, and the three men who had raped her each holding a bloodstained club, a sickle, and a dead young girl by her foot
Iron Bars appears in his blood-red surcoat, saying he’s been looking for Seren for the past two days
In an instant Iron Bars knocked the club-man to the ground, impaled the second with his own sickle, and ripped the jaw from the third man while taking the young girl in his arms
Iron Bars punches the third man’s spine twice breaking bones
Another Crimson Guard shouts for Iron Bars to stop and to kill him cleanly, which Iron Bars does with a swift punch caving in the third man’s skull
Iron Bars approaches Seren and apologizes for not being there
Explains that the Letherii mages died and shadow wraiths swarmed the remaining soldiers while another army of Edur surprised the undermanned fortresses, killing every soldier
Iron Bar says Corlo [a mage] has finally found a warren because of the Edur, after two years of being stuck on the continent, and that his Blade [group] is waiting
Seren unconsciously walks with Iron Bars and he realizes they’ve been cut off
Udinaas follows as Rhulad and twelve other warriors slaughter Letherii
Rhulad fights with skills not his own, gibbering, laughing, and shrieking maniacally
Six of the Edur warriors die
Udinaas followed behind, giving comforting words to the Letherii that died at his feet
Iron Bars appears and kills four Edur, then engages with Rhulad
As Iron Bars and Rhulad cross their blades, Iron Bars twists so that his sword slides above the other allowing Iron Bars to hold Rhulad’s sword with downward pressure
Iron Bars uses his other hand to palm Rhulad’s forehead snapping his neck
As Rhulad falls, Iron Bars swiftly steps forward and kills the last two Edur warriors
Iron Bars nods to Udinaas, waves Seren to come over from the alleyway, takes her hand and walks off
Udinaas sits next to Rhulad waiting for him to wake up
Irons Bars and Seren meet with more Crimson Guards. Two women and four men
Corlo holds a diadem in his hand and opens a warren that will take them to Letheras
Seren realizes belatedly that Iron Bars killed Rhulad
Withal sits on the beach watching Rhulad vomit in the water
The nachts Rind and Pule fight over a piece of driftwood for their nest, only to be inevitably wrecked by Mape
Rhulad begs not to be sent back and for Withal to break the mottled sword
Withal wonders where the Crippled God got the black and brittle pieces to make that sword
Withal realizes the Crippled God lies, and won't be set free
They realize Father Shadow [Scabandari Bloodeye] is dead because he never would’ve let another god take the Edur like this
Rhulad says he's going to kill the Crippled God with the sword and stands up
They both go meet with the Crippled God
Seren and the Crimson Guard were in a maze of obsidian tunnels within Kurald Galain
Corlo is surprised to find Kurald Galain breached, not Kurald Emurlahn, and he’s keeping the Tiste Andii spirits away
The Tiste Andii spirits are bound magically to serve the Edur
Out of curiosity, Corlo lets one Tiste Andii spirit approach
A woman, Sandalath Drukorlat with reddish hair and green eyes. Wearing a letter harness and leggings, and a cloak of white fur
Seren and Sandalath communicate in the Edur language
Sandalath died against K’Chain Che'malle, not Edur but considers them betrayers
Many of the wraiths can resist the Edur and not fight for them, yet they remain trapped
Sandalath agrees to help guide them, even being honest in that her desire is too much to ask of them
Sandalath wants them to walk to the coast where she died, toss the ring into the sea so that it would reunite with her bones and allow her to find oblivion
Sandalath is suspicious, Iron Bars has her touch his chest to prove that he is Avowed and will be faithful to their pact
Sandalath does so and is shocked to feel deep sorrow and trusts them
Iron Bars expresses pity that their gift to her is oblivion
Mape’s on the ground watching Rhulad and Withal approach, and holds up the hammer she stole from Withal’s workshop
Mape scares Withal the most
The Crippled God was surprised to find the Crimson Guard had arrived
He’s glad that it was neither Skinner or Cowl who would've recognized what Rhulad is
Rhulad begs not to go back, that he hasn’t earned any of the desires given to him, to stop being used by the Crippled God
The Crippled God laughs and reveals that Father Shadow is the same and that in truth the Tiste Edur were the ones that betrayed the Tiste Andii
The Crippled God tosses the mottled sword at Rhulad’s feet
Rhulad picks it up and lunges at the Crippled God but vanishes
Withal bitterly argues with the Crippled God and walks away
Seren and the Crimson Guard arrive 30 leagues south of Trate to Old Katter on the coastline
[Note: A league is about the distance you could walk in an hour, 3 miles. So about 90 miles]
Iron Bars tosses the ring, containing Sandalath Drukolat’s spirit, into the water
Seren walks down and washes herself in the water, falls from the waves, and tries to drown herself
Iron Bars grabs her and wraps his arms around her as she’s clawing at him, orders Corlo to heal her and put her to sleep
Sandalath Drukorlat thinks about her husband and daughter that must've moved on past her death by now
Her daughter had fed on draconic blood and became a soletaken eleint like Anomander Rake, and may be a grandmother by now
Sandalath Drukorlat hears [the Crippled God’s] voice call to her
She sees her body climb out of the ocean floor silts and rise up into the air
Sandalath reclaims her body and is alive once more
Udinaas sat watching over Rhulad’s corpse
Hannan Mosag, Mayen, Feather Witch, Midik Buhn, and hundreds other either stand around and witness Rhulad’s revival for the first time, in shrieks and convulsions
Rhulad’s neck snapped back into place
Rhulad orders Hannan Mosag to settle the garrison, camp the Edur outside the city, and send the K’risnan to Old Katter
Midik swears to find the person who did this to him
Rhulad thinks he meant the Crippled God and responds they are helpless against his lies
Udinaas clarifies and gives a description of [Iron Bars] later
Rhulad shrieks at Udinaas to take him out of this place, Udinaas picks him up and they walk through Trate
Withal sits in his smithy contemplating the parody of his life when he hears the Crippled God say he left a gift on the shore
Withal walls to the edge looking down on the beach
The Crippled God had taken Sandalath Drukorlat thinking Withal desired a companion, instead Withal curses at him
Withal went to his cot and knelt down
Withal hated religion, but he made a prayer to Mael, the Elder God of the Sea
Tehol meets with one of three identical brothers Brys sent as his guard. The man never says a word
Tehol watches Bugg fall into the canal, after thinking he heard someone say his name, and walks up to the Tehol’s roof
Tehol named the insect Ezgara and is concerned for its safety from being stepped on
Bugg also brings up a dead cat from the canal for a meal
Tehol shares that Shurq Elalle is going to break into the Tolls Repository
Harlest Eberict tried showing his fangs and talons to Ublala Pung, but Ublala got spooked and sealed him in a sarcophagus within the Jaghut tomb hideout
Bugg reports he finished shoring tunnels under the Eternal Domicile’s Fifth Wing and installed sewage pipes in the Fourth Wing to pack with gravel
Tehol notices the scars all over Bugg’s naked body and gives him his shirt
Tehol, Bugg, and the silent guard walk through the east side shanties
They arrive at the old market where the poor, the refugees from border tribes, and escapees from indebtedness make camp
Tehol tasks Bugg with leading the people the following night
Bugg says as long as he isn't worshiped which he doesn't like
Ceda Kuru Qan summons Brys and reports that Fent Reach surrendered, Trate has fallen, High Fort is next
Queen Janall’s independent army also decided to retreat rather than attack as initially planned
In regards to the enslaved demon spirit-god, Kuru Qan says the Cedance is incomplete, and must conserve his power until he can free the seas [being cryptic]
Kuru Qan speaks on how there should be a Hold of Death, but it doesn't exist
‘The extremity of our judgments, our self-righteousness - all a flight from death, Brys… As if death is the arbiter of meaning, the moment of final judgment…’
The fabric of the world seems to be twisted around the absence of the Hold of Death
Death has no face, shape, or position in their elaborate scheme
Brys offers that life is a celebration of the denial [of death] and mentions that both Kettle and Shurq Elalle are undead
Kuru Qan is excited by the detail and wants to go see them at once
Shurq wants Kettle’s help in recruiting the ghosts of the Azath tower to help break into the Tolls Repository
All of the ghosts agree to go
Kettle and the ghosts are becoming more alive ever since the Azath tower died
Kettle watched Shurq leave with thousands of ghosts follower her
Kettle’s wounds were closing, hearing becoming sharper, heart beating 8 times a day
Kettle pries a flagstone loose with carvings of shells, plants, coral, and bones
Brys and Kuru Qan approach
Kettle had sensed when Kuru Qan used the Cedance to scry on her
Kuru Qan wonders at the Azath Hold’s disappearance, and the [Forkrul Assail] heart thawing in Kettle
Kettle mentions the Nameless Ones took her body so the heart won't ever completely wake up
Kuru Qan thinks the grounds have become the Hold of Death
Kettle hands Kuru Qan the flagstone tile for the Cedance
Kuru Qan wonders how the Nameless Ones, servants of the Azath, had outlived the First Empire
Kettle mentions a very pretty man with lots of girlfriends and boyfriends would occasionally visit her and follow her when she hunts
The pretty man would tell her never to give her heart away, and that the Hold of Death doesn't need a guardian because the throne is already occupied [Note: By Hood] everywhere else
Brys and Kuru Qan leave
Kettle walks over to her ‘friend’s’ barrow, takes his hand, and appears on a low hill with a vast shadow valley of corpses below them
A black mountain was smoking in the distance
The corpses were K’Chain Che'Malle, Andii, and Edur
Locqui Wyval walk the valley looking for their master
Kettle's 'friend' says a Jaghut is about to seal all of it in ice including their spirits barring them from passing on
The uncle didn't know the Azath tower became the Hold of Death
The uncle will kill the Edur when they come to Letheras
The true threat, however, lies in the Azath barrows still
The spirits are all gone, he asks Kettle where they all went
The Tolls Repository is in a panic as the Azath tower ghosts swarm the building
Shurq has a former employee of the Tolls Repository guide her and gather the exact information she needed [who holds the largest royal debt]
Shurq has to coral them, prevent the ex-employee from starting a fire, and others from stealing money
Kuru Qan succinctly summarizes the plot of Midnight Tides thus far as he and Brys walks back to the royal palace
Kuru Qan received witness reports of Rhulad being cut down and coming back to life
Kuru Qan is troubled by the Seventh Closure prophecy
Prophecy that arose towards the end of the First Empire
The Letherii have lost knowledge from that time
Sorcery gone awry, birthing of horrific beasts [the Beast Ritual that spawned soletaken and d’ivers]
The armies of undead that slaughtered their people [T’lan Imass]
Mysterious tales of a strange realm of magic torn apart [either Kurald Emurlahn or another unnamed warren that was shattered simultaneously creating the otataral isles]
Names unfamiliar to Kuru Qan: Barghast, Jhag, Trell
Brys and Kuru Qan enter the royal palace
Chief Inspector Rucket of the Rat Catcher’s Guild moves through the crowds in old market of the east side shanties to Tehol
Rucket ridicules Tehol’s shirt, trousers, and the insect on his shoulder
Rucket tries to ask Tehol out on a date
Tehol suggests The Trampled Peacock, which he owns
Bugg appears after finishing his task and they all go to the Trampled Peacock together
Tehol, Bugg, and Rucket arrive at the Trampled Peacock and see Shand, Rissarh, and Hejun
For some dumb reason they start fighting
Rissarh jumps over the table and grapples Rucket’s legs
Rucket slaps Rissarh on the arm with her rapier, making Rissarh drop her knife
Hejun twist’s Rucket’s grip on her sword loose and yeets it, Rucket kicks Hejun in the gut
Tehol orders four bottles of wine for the ladies after they finish fighting, Tehol and Bugg leave the tavern
Tehol is tempted to collect firewood from the broken pieces of the tavern
Tehol and Bugg return home
A group of Nerek survived the Letherii sorcerous attack because they huddled on consecrated ground
[Note: The ground was sanctified when Mayen gave them her blessing]
A Nerek youth dreams, something that hasn't happened since the Letherii conquered the border tribes
The dreams revealed the old paths, the ways through and between worlds
The Nerek youth and his knife-sharer are sent to find Hull Beddict [whom was loved by the border tribe people]
Fear leads Trull away into a secluded glade so he could choke Trull and try to force him to stop voicing doubts against Rhulad
Trull stays silent and Fear let's him go
Fear admits he’d assassinate Trull because he'd lose to him in combat
With the only voice of reason within the Edur, Trull says they are serving the power bringing Rhulad back and not Rhulad himself
Trull sees his brother suffering with every death and losing sanity, trapped in a mangled, disfigured body that's in chronic pain
Fear covers his ears like a child and eventually compromises by letting Trull voice his doubts only Fear
Moroch Nevath, the Prince’s guard, stood on the rampart outside High Fort assessing the Letherii’s preparations
Grass Jackets Brigade, eleven sorcerers between the Queen and the Prince’s mage cadres
Ramparts, ramparts, ramparts
Deer grass on the fields unaware of what’s about to happen
Moroch expects that their mages will cancel each other out, and the battle will depend on the physical armies
Shadow wraiths came from the forest, followed by a hundred giant demons, Edur warriors, and fur-clad savages [Jheck]
The Queen’s armor was gaudy with gold and silver filigree, beadwork, and pearls on her sword’s pommel
Moroch Nevath felt something was terribly wrong
Around 60,000 Edur warriors approached High Fort
The K’risnan cast their sorcery, grey mist tendrils swirled around them and formed a fluid web that thickened and rose
Strands of the entwined around the Edur and created a billowing grey wall among the Edur ranks
The sorcery made Trull nauseous
The Letherii mage cadre strikes first by hurling a wall of fire at the Edur
At the last second, the grey mist web rushed out and collides with the fire wall, sending it skyward into a pillar of silver fire
Trull thought he saw thousands of bones in the fire
The silver fire pillars toppled backwards towards High Fort and explodes when touching the ground, the bones hailing down onto Letherii entrenchments
The shadow wraiths and demons rush forward
The K’risnan create a wall of bone and flesh from the dead body parts of the Letherii
The flesh wall rushes to engulf the Queen’s mage cadre and explodes, killing two of the four mages
A mace wielding demon kills the third mage
The fourth mage casts flickering magic that swarmed the demon, killing it
The Letherii cast a rolling column of sorcery that crackled with lightning, sweeping across the shadow wraiths and Edur warriors
A K’risnan casts another surge of Letherii bone walls
In the distance another Letherii-cast detonation kills hundreds of Edur
Trull reaches the first trench towards High Fort, the pit is filled with bones, organs, and gore of the Letherii
The air smelled of burnt meat and ruptured bowels releasing fecal odors
Gagging, Trull walked across stepping into puddles of blood and bile
Trull watches demons and wraiths battle with the enemy falling to their ballista, and the Edur finally reach and make contact with the Letherii
Moroch Nevath screamed Quillas’ name looking for him in the chaos
Bleeding from the ears after the concussion caused by the K’risnan’s bone wall explosions
Watches as [Trull] impales the last mage with his blackwood spear, lifts her up, and flings her away
The iron spear point breaks off
The ground quakes, Moroch’s leg slides on slime and pulls his groin muscle that pains up through his spine
Moroch is in a nightmare crawling along the ground as bone hails from the sky and the air is filled with screams
Trull climbs onto a pile of corpses to get a better view of the field
The Letherii were now fleeing southward
Jheck, demons, and Edur were furthering slaughtering the Letherii
Fear was alone in the far distance, standing above a body of a K’risnan
Ahlrada Ahn approaches Trull, has a large wound that he needs to go see a healer form
Trull orders him to gather the rest of the warriors for further combat, while Trull goes to Fear
Moroch Nevath is in disbelief that the Edur had won
An Edur approaches Moroch Nevath and notices he is not wounded
Prince Quillas and Queen Janall have been captured
Trate, High Fort, and Fort Shake have all fallen. The Edur will march next to Letheras
The Edur aren't committing genocide, but making the Letherii their subjects in conquest
There are other Letherii soldiers that have no wounds but surrendered
It starts to rain
The region around High Fort has become a swamp of blood and bone
Trull approaches a dying demon, Lilac
Lilac was a simple caster of nets with a family and doesn't know what he dies for
Trull steps away from Lilac to see the K’risnan that Fear was looking over
The K’risnan was a young man, Hanradi Khalag’s son
Body twisted and deformed, skin sloughing off in west sheets
The Edur healers explained the body can’t handle the power gifted by [the Crippled God]
The boy will survive, crippled

cards.h: ***Gothos’ sorcery and the Hold of Death

i.html: In the prologue, Mael had asked Gothos to preserve the land instead of destroying everything after the battle between the Tiste Andii/Edur and the K’Chain Che’Malle. Through his Omtose Phellack sorcery, he froze the continent sealing the death that happened here. As a consequence, it also closed the Hold of Death.

As a result of Gothos sealing the Hold of Death in the Lether region, the dead continue to linger. That’s why the Tiste Andii that died became wraiths. That’s why there’s so many undead character like Shurq Elalle, Kettle, and Harlest Eberict. There was nowhere else for them to go, all souls just lingered.
For tens of thousands of years, death in the Lether region was different from the rest of the world.

Hull thinks it’s a small amount and his brother Tehol owns Huldo
Hull tells a story of how a lender bought a family debt to try and force their parents to give up a holding
Tehol finessed his tutor to let him ditch school to start his own business
Tehol had  two Nerek employees that sifted through sewage, returning lost jewelry which made him rich
Tehol paid off the family debt, and retaliated by coordinating debts to be called on the same lender, financially ruining him
As Tehol’s brother, Hull clears Udinaas’ debt and enjoyed their conversation
‘I am without expectation, Udinaas’
Rhulad clarifies to Udinaas that he wasn’t sick with a fever
He ‘traveled’ to strike a deal [with the Kenryll’ah tyrant] by drowning an entire fragment of Kurald Emurlahn
[Note: Now we know why the Nascent is flooded]
The Edur will sail the flooded world to seek lost kin and champions capable of killing Rhulad
Rhulad becomes more powerful with each death
Rhulad is scared by his own power, Udinaas says that makes Rhulad responsible
Hannan Mosag deals with conflicts between the Edur tribes that threaten the unity
They drink wine and Udinaas tells him the eel and poison lake story
Deadhouse Gates
The flooded warren of the Nascent which Felisin, Baudin, Heboric, Kulp, Stormy, Gesler, and Truth were on.
The party was pulled into the Nascent by an unnamed insane mage
The grey-skinned warriors are Tiste Edur, the severed heads are Tiste Andii
The ship is the Silanda, a pre-Empire Quon Tali dromon that was the only ship allowed to trade with the Tiste Andii island of Drift Avalii
The Silanda disappeared when Kellanved founded the Malazan Empire, conquered Quon Tali, and ended trade with Drift Avalii
The Nascent is Kurald Emurlahn, Elder Warren of Shadow and of the Tiste Edur

Kulp has the party escape the Nascent by using his Meanas, human path shadow warren, to trick reality by imposing his own illusions, following an undead dragon “the Unwelcome” into Meanas itself and Tellann, the Elder Warren of fire and of the Imass
The event turned Stormy, Gesler, and Truth into ascendants that tempered their skin bronze
House of Chains
Karsa Orlong ended up in the Nascent with Torvald Nom. There they fought with giant black cat fish, joined with Slavemaster Silgar to escape

Trull Sengar was chained and made bald as apart of the Shorning that the Tiste Edur committed against him. Onrack the Broken comes along, wandering without much memory of his past, until he found Trull and released him out of simple curiosity.

They traveled through the breach in the wall holding the water, falling down to a lower escalation. They found and possibly released two Deragoth trapped in some statues. They also discovered the remnants of a vast city.
They encountered a T’lan Imass group hunting the renegade Unbound T’lan Imass (Seven Faces in the Rock, gods to the Teblor). There was also another group of Tiste Liosan
The Crimson Rampant Brigade, the Snakebelt Battalion, and the Riven Brigade camp at Dissent (unmapped)
Seren Pedac wants to go home to Letheras to message her two house staff and clean up her house
Iron Bars says they’ll part ways so the Crimson Guard to meet up with their new employer
Seren rejects his offer to join them on their boat
Corlo warns her to ease up on the Mockra
Trull’s army is about to join with Rhulad’s army at Bran’s Keep
Tomad and Binadas’ army is heading to White Point, where they’ll meet with the other two armies at Bran’s Keep and the battle will decide the war
Fear, Trull, and B’nagga ride on horses to meet Rhulad
Trull sees that Rhulad has changed. He’s more bulky, his forehead exposed, skin the color of dark snow, dark eye bags, expression grimace from chronic pain
Rhulad stood with Hull Beddict and Hannan Mosag
Hannan Mosag, Hull Beddict, and B’nagga leave to discuss their battle plans
Udinaas leads Rhulad, Fear, and Trull into the command tent
The three Sengar brothers sit down awkwardly for wine
Rhulad demands that he be called by his name and not by his title of emperor
Their mother Uruth is taking care of Mayen who’s ill
Rhulad apologies to Fear about Mayen
Udinaas explain that Mayen is pregnant and still in love with Fear. Rhulad is willing to divorce Mayen, but the child makes things complicated
Rhulad says the child will never be heir, the throne is Rhulad’s eternal burden
Trull is shocked how Rhulad is matured, and that Udinaas might be responsible
Fear agrees to be with Mayen again and raise the child
Mayen is punishing herself with an addiction to white nectar, which will affect the baby
The Sengar brothers eat and drink, enjoying each other’s company
After some time, Trull gets up and walk in on Udinaas eating dinner by himself
Trull asks what he is to Rhulad, Udinaas replies ‘his friend’
Trull sternly says never to betray Rhulad which annoys Udinaas
Trull feels bad and thanks Udinaas before returning to the dinner table
Trull comes back, Hannan Mosag is there reporting that something had been freed in Brous that they must deal with before continuing to Bran’s Keep
Rhulad decides himself, Fear, Trull, Hull Beddict, and Udinaas will go
Hannan Mosag suggests they bring a K’risnan and their two Kenryll’ah demons
Trull jokes that if only Binadas was there because their Warlock King is sending them on another quest
Trull, Fear, and Rhulad all laugh together in genuine amusement
Seren and the Crimson Guard reach Letheras
The King’s Battalion and the Merchant’s Battalion are outside, led by Preda Unnutal Hebaz who’s having trouble with her horse
Iron Bars makes it firm that they’re going to escort Seren to her doorstep even if it’s out of the way for them
Brys Beddict stands by as King Diskanar looks over his balcony watching the army leave the city towards Bran’s Keep, which they expect the battle to be days away
Brys calls for a messenger to send messages.
To Tehol that he stay on his roof, and to the Shavankrat the name Gerun Eberict
Brys walks inside where Moroch Nevath waits for him
Moroch asks if Brys believes in gods and if he knows where Turudal Brizad is
Brizad has been missing and assumed to have fled the city
Morch hands Brys an old ceramic tile of the Errant, thinks Turudal Brizad is the Errant
After Brizad asked Moroch to [kill the Pack, the god of the Jheck], Moroch realized Turudal Brizad has existed in every generation of Letherii history
Before Brizad left, he was seen watching the last refugees enter the city yesterday morning
Moroch asks Brys for advice, Brys says he should do what the god asked
Moroch leaves
Brys goes to the dome chamber and finds Kuru Qan asleep on the center tile
Brys tells Kuru Qan to move because the King is about to begin the investiture
Kuru Qan refuses and yells the place belongs to him and threatens to obliterate anyone who tries to move him
Kuru Qan tells him the King is ready and that the King should ignore Kuru Qan
The Kenryll’ah demons remark on the smell of rotting corpses
The Kenryll’ah were black skinned, sharper facial features than Lilac, canines protruding from their mouths with glinting silver
Wore a fur-lined collar, bronze scale vest with dark patina, heavy leather belt, grey leather leggings
One had a tulwar (curved thin sword), the other had a mattock (farming pickaxe)
The ‘tyrant brothers’ bickered and complained the entire time
The Arapay K’risnan senses that the ‘thing’ in the town and is aware of the Edur’s arrival
Udinaas is left with the horses while the rest enter Brous
The entire village appeared to have been slaughtered, Trull cut loose horses that had been trapped
Serenity, Forkrul Assail with pallid yellow hair surrounded by a flock of black starling birds appears
The Arapay K’risnan is unable to banish him
[Note: Brous is the village where the captain declared independence and tried to conscript the Crimson Guard. The group was trying to excavate the demon for their mage to bind it. Clearly it failed.]
Serenity declares their presence invites discord and attacks
Trull attempts to sweep with his spear, Serenity wraps her right multi-jointed arm around it and cracks the blackwood shaft
With her left hand, Serenity taps Trull’s forehead knocking him off his feet, nearly snapping his neck
Fear attacks Serenity’s knee, but her knee bends backwards. Serenity plucks the sword with her left hand and shatters the iron blade just by squeezing it
Rhulad attacks, Serenity ‘simply flowed around’ the mottled blade and pierced his heart with her fingers
Serenity leaps 8 paces back to dodge the two Kenryll’ah demons attacks
Udinaas rushes in to give Trull a spear (which he left behind on the horses)
The demon kicks Serenity, cracking her ribs and knocks her to the ground
As the demon rushed her right side, Trull throws the spear into her left collarbone and the demon’s tulwar cuts into the right thighbone
Udinaas places another spear in Trull’s hand and he reaches his hand back
Serenity bled blue blood, her wounds were rapidly closing, and she attempts to flee
Trull calls out to halt the Kenryll’ah, letting Serenity escape
The Arapay K’risnan is shook by the Forkrul Assail’s power
The demons are determined to not like the Forkrul Assail and kill him
Fear eventually lets the Kenryll’ah go and pursue Serenity

Sandalath Drukorlat wants to help Rhulad who's washed up on the beach, right up until he gets pissy and yells at her calling her a betrayer [because she’s Tiste Andii, despite visiting the Stone Bowl and knowing the truth behind the Betrayal]
Sand and Withal agree that they are not lovers
Withal leaves to pray to his god [Mael] hoping he'd take pity on him
Annoyed that they had to walk around Kuru Qan on the floor, the King and his entourage are in the throne room
Nifadas, Nisall, Brys, Gerun Eberict, and twelve soldiers were present
Riots are happening all over Letheras
The investiture begins, Nifadas crowns Ezgara Diskanar as Emperor turning the Letherii kingdom into an empire
Diskanar sits there looking frail and lost
[The Seventh Closure prophecies that a new empire would rise around this time. The Letherii believe it was for Diskanar to reclaim the glory of the First Empire]
Seren and the Crimson Guard ride through the streets of Letheras to Seren’s home
The streets were littered with dead bodies, blood stains, refugee families, and feral dogs
The city still remained in riot with a new one happening in the distance
The Crimson Guard leave, Iron Bars says he’ll come back the next day to check up on her before departing
Seren walks into her home, walks around the dead owl on the floor, and sits at her table feeling lonely as ever

cards.h: Scene 8 (Near the Old Palace, Turudal Brizad)

i.html: Bells ring as the investiture crowning Diskanar as Emperor is completed
Tehol was on his way to Selush to help Shurq Elalle get her diamond studded stopper
Kettle is alive singing at the Azath tower where tens of thousands of starling birds swarm
Turudal Brizad, confirmed to be the Errant, thinks how tragic the Letherii miscalculated the Seventh Closure prophecy which was two days off
[The Letherii worshipped the Errant as an ‘eternally mysterious purveyor of chance, fateful circumstance and ill-chosen impulses’]
A Fulcra tile [The Errant. Bearer of unknowable laws, draws Fire and Dolmen into war.]
Feather Witch’s first Tile casting [The Errant returns, and casts seeds into blood-soaked earth. Thus rises the Hold of the Azath. Deadly shelter for tyrants.]

[The tread of time is itself a prison. We are shackled with progression. The Errant comes once more, and the Ice Hold rises with its attendant servants who journey through the realms to war against time.]
Udinaas, Fear, Trull, and the Arapay K’risnan witness Rhulad screaming and shrieking his way back to life, weeping in Udinaas's arms
They rode back to rejoin the Edur army five leagues (hours) away from Bran’s Keep
Feather Witch stands near him on a rise, being a tsundere. Shadow wraiths surround and protect them
Udinaas looks out at Bran’s Keep, sees the citadel carved into the cliff, mangonels, mages in each tower preparing a ritual, and all the brigades and battalions lined up along the ridge and lake
Feather Witch says Mayen is doing bad from her white nectar addiction
The slaves tending to the addiction advise weaning Mayen off of it, but Uruth doesn't listen
Feather Witch can also see all of the Edur have changed ‘as if fevered’ with a ‘fire behind their eyes’ and they're unaware of it
Udinaas recognizes that Trull Sengar is the one person that’s different
Strange sorcery appears in the sky, Udinaas remembers how the [Crippled God’s] power twists their bodies
Ahlrada Ahn stood next to Trull Sengar, ready to battle.
Fear, Rhulad, the K’risnan, thousands of Jheck, a dozen Kenryll’ah each leading a score (20) of Kenryll'ah peasants
The two K’risnan summon dark dust spiral pillars, while the Letherii conjure walls of white fire that crackled lightning
The spiralling dust pillars begin to topple
Udinaas sees waves of shadow wraiths flow forward as fodder
The dust pillars clash with the wall of fire
Feather Witch senses the Empty Hold, ‘the purest sorcery of the Letherii’
Preda Unnutal Hebaz watches the dust pillars slowly fall over them
The mages complete their ritual casting releasing fire towards the dust pillars
Earthquakes violently shake the Keep
The front wall crumples inward
The water from the artificial lake lifts up
The towers collapse
All of the dust rises and joins the dust pillars
The Letherii’s fire disperses against the dust pillars
The dust pillars fall onto the soldiers, lifting them up into the sky as the dust shreds their flesh apart
The Preda simply closes her eyes
Ahlrada Ahn and Trull watch the dust pillars disintegrate the majority of the Letherii brigades and battalions
Ahlrada Ahn is in horror and wants it to stop
Trull thinks Hannan Mosag controls the sorcery and has gone made
Waves of fire sideswipes against the dust pillars and fall, incinerating thousands of Edur soldiers, K’risnan, Kenryll’ah demons, and shadow wraiths
One wave of fire strikes the encampment that had Edur women, elders, and children
Ahlrada Ahn pulls Trull forward
Udinaas sees a wave of fire heading towards him, he's ready to die
Uruth and other women send wraiths to counter the fire, protecting Udinaas and Feather Witch
Two Edur women’s, and later a third, blood boils. They fall over, dead
Smaller dust pillars rise and tear apart the battlefield and the artificial lake
The Letherii soldiers break formation and flee as Edur, Jheck, and Kenryll'ah demons hunt them down
Flesh bits, limbs, bones, ribs, teeth, broken pieces of armor and weapons rain down on the battlefield
Udinaas tells the shocked Feather Witch to go help Uruth while he goes towards Hull Beddict who’s walking in the distance
Hull is in shock, Udinaas tries to convince him that the battle is over and turns him around
Hull threatens to kill him and Udinaas let's him go
Udinaas sees Rhulad walking towards Hannan Mosag and runs to hear what they'll say
Trull and Ahlrada look over the battlefield, the Tiste Edur have won
Sergeant Canarth comes, insults Ahlrada for being a Betrayer with his half Tiste Andii blood, says it's why he keep defending Trull
Trull challenges Canarth to a duel
Canarth thrusts forward with his spear
Trull parries, the blackwood shafts impacting each other
Canarth pulls back and swings the butt-end up expecting to parry a sweep
Instead, Trull holds his spear horizontally and slams the midshaft onto Canarth’s forehead, cracking the skin and knocking him on his back
Trull spares Canarth against Ahlrada’s insistence and wants to keep it secret from Fear
Trull and Ahlrada walk away to greet Tomad and Binadas
Udinaas watches as Rhulad, Hannan Mosag, and Rhulad's old entourage return to the Edur camps and walk up the slope
Old entourage: Theradas Buhn, Midik Buhn, Choram Irard, Kholb Harat, Matra Brith
Udinaas feels the old entourage are like factions within Letherii court
Theradas pushes Udinaas down and the old entourage laugh at him
Rhulad asks who did it, Udinaas said they simply bumped into each other
Hannan Mosag declares they have won
Rhulad reaches the top of the slope and screams, there’s no one left to fight and thousands of their people are dead.
Despite winning, Rhulad feels like he lost
Rhulad appears to have been walking to strike Hannan Mosag
Udinaas calls out to Rhulad to announce his father and brothers are coming, interrupting him
Rhulad is angered and horrified by the slaughter caused Hannan Mosag’s dust pillars
[Note: Rhulad doesn't want to commit genocide, the original intent was to make the Letherii into subjects of the Edur empire. Rhulad still wants to be an honorable person]
[Note: Hannan Mosag, on the other hand, prioritizes the lives of the Edur and wants to minimize Edur deaths no matter the cost]
Rhulad is about to settle into cold grief, but the sword makes Rhulad spasm into hot rage
Udinaas calms him down, to plan an announcement to express disapproval of Hannan Mosag’s slaughter
Hannan Mosag calls out to Rhulad but is waved away
Theradas Buhn worms his way into Rhulad’s good graces
Binadas appears and kneels before Rhulad. Rhulad asks if he's with the Edur or Hannan Mosag
Binadas is confused, but answers his army with Tomad was victorious without sorcery
Hull Beddict approaches, still in shock
Their father Tomad reports their mother Uruth is recovering
Fear reports that they can assume the two Kenryll’ah demons are still hunting the Forkrul Assail
Rhulad expressed to Hull that he grieves and would’ve rather had an honourable clean triumph, not a day of slaughter
Rhulad tells his father to bury the Letherii with the Edur, as they are also the subjects of the Edur Empire
Binadas spoke a few words to Hannan Mosag, then walked over to his blood-bonded brother Hull Beddict and led him away
Fear and Tomad left to deal with the burial
Trull and Udinaas stood together looking over the hills
Trull recognizes that Udinaas is very intelligent and asks what his goal is
‘Enough of this “master” shit, Udinaas.’
Udinaas jokes that he is symbolically the First Eunuch if he has a position in the Edur Empire
Trull wonders if Udinaas is arrogant to stand between Rhulad and Hannan Mosag, the entourage, etc.
Udinaas responds that none of them are where they are by choice
Udinaas’s goal is for people to not be more hurt than they already are
Trull and Udinaas are all they have to hold the world together as it unravels
The enslaved demon spirit-god pulled the Edur ships through the river towards Letheras
Ahead was a strange, yet familiar heart to the demon. A source of power beneath Letheras that would break the sea-god’s enslavement that [Hannan Mosag] knew nothing about
Water possessed the sacred power of gods in its ceaseless motion, yet was senseless
Entities harnessed the powers of the waters and thus became lords of the seas
Rivers and lakes fed the oceans, thus the power of those rivers and lakes would be even more powerful than the seas
The enslaved demon spirit-god was excited
Selush and Tehol marvel at Shurq’s new diamond studded stopper covering the gash in her head made by the iron spike that impaled her
Selush jokes that working on Shurq’s grey skin was great practice for when the Tiste Edur conquer Letheras, calling her first makeup line ‘Dead Thief of the Night’
Selush leaves to hide in her basement during the battle and advises them to do the same
The time is dark, near dawn
Tehol doesn’t know where Bugg is
The Shavankrat is keeping watch above, the messenger girl Brys sent had visited
[Note: Her message was ‘Gerun Eberict’]
When Shurq left her Jaghut tomb hideout, Harlest was making hissing and scratching noises in his sarcophagus while Ublala was muttering how he’d dismember him
Tehol and Shurq climb onto the roof, the Shavankrat points towards the Edur fleet on the river, about an hour away from reaching Letheras
Shurq leaves
Bells frantically ring to announce the arrival of the Edur
The Eternal Domicile is in a strange calm
‘Emperor’ Diskanar is asleep from exhaustion on his throne, while First Concubine Nisall stayed up all night as if her love could protect him
Chancellor Triban Gnol had been like a ghost ever since Prince Quillas and Queen Janall were captured
First Consort Turudal Brizad looked exhausted, walking the halls speaking to no one
Finadd Moroch Nevath disappeared [tasked by Brizad to kill the Pack, god of the Jheck], though Brys was confident he’d show up when he is needed
First Eunuch Nifadas took care of the soldiers, looking more alert and awake than he’s ever been
Brys tells Nifadas that the Edur might not kill them all, seeing the value in their knowledge
Finadd Gerun Eberict is supposed to be in charge of the garrisons and the soldiers throughout the city
Brys tries to give Nisall cushions to rest on, she refuses at first but eventually falls fast asleep
Brys walks out to the King’s Path dome where Gerun Eberict contemplates killing Ceda Kuru Qan, asleep on the center tile
Brys challenges Gerun Eberict regardless of the King’s Leave, Gerun relents and leaves
Brys wish he could’ve killed Gerun Eberict right there and then
Choosing honor over blood, he apologizes to Tehol
Bugg stood on Letheras’ unmanned walls and merlons looking out to the Edur fleet sailing on the river
A scraggly artist painted the Edur’s standard on a canvas two arm-lengths wide
A rough diagonal of red and muddy brown
Bugg walks down to the streets to the temple dedicated to the Pack, where Turudal Brizad stands
Turudal Brizad is nervous that [Moroch Nevath] hasn’t appeared yet
As the Errant, has prohibitions. Brizad can only nudge, push or pull
Turudal Brizad asks Bugg for suggestions, Bugg says he’ll try to persuade someone
Bugg walks to the docks, watching at the Edur were landing unopposed and taking their time
Bugg walks onto a ship finding the Crimson Guard and Shand
The ship belongs to Tehol and Shurq, who planned on becoming pirates.
[Note: Shurq hired the Crimson Guard off-screen as her crewmates]
Bugg recruits the Crimson Guard to kill the Pack, god of the Soletaken Jheck
Iron Bars says it won’t take long
Shand asks how Bugg knew they’d be here, Bugg says ‘Errant’s nudge, I suppose’
Fifty steps away from Letheras’s gates
Hannan Mosag and the K’risnan sends the shadow wraiths into the city
Hannan Mosag only senses a handful of mages, not the Ceda. He figures they’ll reach the Eternal Domicile by noon
Rhulad places Udinaas under Uruth’s responsibility to keep him safe
Udinaas will be sent if Rhulad is killed
Rhulad leads the Edur into Letheras
Trull is suspicious of Hannan Mosag
(Hull Beddict)
Hull Beddict entered Letheras with the second company of Edur, ignored by everyone
The first battles with the Letherii barricades is heard in the distance
Hull in determined in the justice of deposing King Diskanar who betrayed him
Hull is sad that his brother Brys Beddict is as good as dead, but necessary
Hull goes to find Tehol Beddict to try and seek forgiveness
(Udinaas)
Udinaas waits with the Sengar household until it was their turn to enter Letheras
Mayen looked haunted, Uruth watched over her only to care for the baby inside her
Udinaas panics as the Wyval inside him is burning up
(B’nagga)
In their Soletaken wolf forms, B’nagga leads the 9,000 Jheck into Letheras towards the temple dedicated to the Pack, their god
B’nagga plans for the Jheck to ascend and tear apart the Edur, giving rise to of an empire of Soletaken
Finadd Moroch Nevath had his soldiers form a shield-wall guarding the bridge that crossed the Main Canal
Moroch wanted to redeem himself from the rumors of his cowardice at High Fort
Decided not to listen to Turudal Brizad and fight his own battles against the Edur
Rhulad leads the Edur forward, Moroch Nevath directly challenges him
Bugg leads the Crimson Guard towards Turudal Brizad
Hears the howling of the Jheck wolves
Corlo senses six [of the D’ivers of the Pack] inside
Turudal Brizad simply points into the temple without the word and the Crimson Guard sprints inside
Iron Bars says ‘Pleased-to-meet-you-see-you-later’ as he runs by
Immediately noises of bestial screams, human shouts, and sorcery are head inside
Rhulad accepts Moroch Nevath’s challenge against Hannan Mosag’s advice
Rhulad wants to fight honourably and give the Letherii an honourable death
Fear recognizes Moroch Nevath as part of the Letherii delegation and thinks Nevath wants to be killed by the emperor of the Edur
(Moroch Nevath)
Rhulad swings the mottled sword and knocks Moroch’s helmet off
Moroch slashed Rhulad’s right thigh
Rhulad makes a two-handed thrust, avoiding Moroch’s parry attempt, and slashes through Moroch’s right hip
Moroch buries his sword into Rhulad’s left armpit, scraping along his ribs, shoulder-blade, and coins
Rhulad buries the mottled sword into Moroch’s right hip through to his groin
Rhulad pushed down on the mottled sword’s hilt down onto the floor, slashing the blade up into Moroch’s guts
Rhulad stands up and pushes the mottled sword through the torso, along the heart and left lung, through to the left clavicle
Moroch pushes against his sword and snaps Rhulad’s spine
Both Rhulad and Moroch falls to the floor
One of the Sengar brothers ask for Moroch’s name, but he was drowning in his blood
Moroch’s soldiers shout out, calling him the King’s Champion
Moroch dies with the pleasing thought, ‘You bastards have not met him yet.’
(Rhulad Sengar)
Rhulad immediately revives to the horror of the Letherii soldiers and screams out Udinaas’s name
(Uruth Sengar)
Uruth Sengar hears the screams of her son Rhulad and looks for Udinaas, but he’s gone missing
Mayen screams and runs off, disappearing into an alley
(Azath grounds, Kettle)
Kettle cries as she hides from the fighting in the city
The Five [Toblakai] were almost free
Kettle cries for her friends and reaches down to the barrow of her ‘friend’ and is dragged down
Kettle finds herself in a fetid swamp under a grey sky
Kettle’s friend, who had long white hair, was being dragged down by a muscular woman, he tells her to grab his two swords
Kettle grabs the swords and waits as limbs appeared from the water
[Note: The same swords that Brys took from Kuru Qan’s collection]
(Udinaas)
Udinaas, possessed by the Wyval, runs through the city, in search of his Master
Udinaas turns his hands into eleint talons to kill several Soletaken Jheck
Turudal Brizad, the Errant, finds it a lot easier than expected to nudge the Jheck away from the temple, even easier as they keep running into enemies
The Crimson Guard limps out, Corlo dragging a dead female comrade
Turudal Brizad repairs another Guardsman’s arm that was hanging by a few tendons off the shoulder
Iron Bars walks out, pissed they were expecting wolves but instead fought D’ivers lizard cats
The Pack, god of the Jheck, is dead
Iron Bars rushes to catch B’nagga lunging at Turudal Brizad, choking it as he slammed the Soletaken into the wall crushing it. It died as it involuntarily vomits and urinates
Bugg knew that the crew had escaped Assail
Turudal Brizad says he’ll ensure their a clear path back to their ship
Bugg senses [the Five Toblakai] escaping
Iron Bars sighs and decides to take care of it too as the rest of the Crimson Guard returns to the ship, needing to vent his frustration of getting pissed on
Bugg is amused that Iron Bars calls the dead Azath House a ‘garden fête’
Turudal Brizad leaves to attend to another matter

Brys listens to Kuru Qan laugh and mutter himself on the floor, as he concentrates on luring the enslaved demon spirit-god to the underground cave beneath Letheras, baiting him with the ‘heart of power’ and partnering with Bugg
At the Azath grounds, Bugg tells Iron Bars to go ahead first and find [Kettle]
Bugg calls out to the Jaghut Huntress to call in the favour for helping with the Khalibaral demon
The Jaghut Huntress calls him clever
The enslaved demon-spirit god realizes the illusion and finds himself sealed in the cave in ice, frozen by the Jaghut Huntress
Ursto Hoobutt and Pinosel drink wine in celebration of ending their debts
The Settle Lake in front of them instantaneously freezes
Ursto Hoobutt agrees to marry Pinosel that moment
Shurq Elalle walks into the Jaghut tomb hideout
Shurq is worried about Gerun Eberict hunting Tehol and about Kettle coming back to life
Ublala Pung sits on Harlest Eberict’s sarcophagus perturbed about the Seregahl, the Tarthenal gods
Ublala tells Shurq he loves her before leaving
Shurq opens the sarcophagus to Harlest hissing and takes him to a cemetery, which makes him excited
Rhulad has gone insane, sitting in the street clawing his eyes out, spontaneously shrieking as Letherii soldiers and citizens watch him
Trull and Uruth stand by, angry that Udinaas had disappeared
Hannan Mosag tries to convince Rhulad that Udinaas is a traitor just like any other Letherii and that he could only trust his fellow Edur
Rhulad calls the Edur all liars, cheats, betrayers. He whips his sword, flinging bits of flesh and blood onto the feet of the Edur near him
Fear steps in front of Rhulad, Rhulad points his mottled sword at his throat
Rhulad orders Hannan Mosag to kill the Letherii soldiers in front of them
The K’risnan and Binadas step forward dragging large leather sacks, but Hannan Mosag stops them to prepare something simpler
Uruth tells Trull that Mayen also escaped
Trull orders the Buhn brothers to find Mayen, and give them leave to kill Udinaas on sight
A grey wave of sorcery washes over the bridge, shredding apart the Letherri soldiers, citizens, and the street itself
Rhulad shouts for Hannan Mosag to stop

The Warlock King of the Tiste Edur, Hannan Mosag, made a deal with the Crippled God for power to unite the Edur tribes and defend themselves against the Letherii Empire. These powers included potent sorcery and enslaving an ancient demon-spirit god.

Lether sailors had breached a treaty and illegally hunted seal tusks on Tiste Edur territory. The Letherii instigated this event (1) to use the death of the (indebted) sailors to make the Edur indebted to the Letherii and (2) possibly instigate a war. Hannan Mosag, however, does not want to pursue conquest. Instead, Hannan Mosag nearly swindled the Crippled God to obtain the power to defend his people and sue for peace.

Hannan Mosag’s plan almost worked, until he sent the Sengar and Buhn brothers to retrieve a gift that Hannan Mosag saw in a dream. That gift was a mottled sword, crafted by the Meckros smith Withal, and Rhulad wielded it to defend his family against the Jheck who wanted it for themselves. The Crippled God saw opportunity to take revenge against Hannan Mosag and to use Rhulad’s ambition and naivete for himself.

Rhulad accepts the Crippled God’s bargain, becoming his champion that gets stronger and more insane every time he dies and always revives. The Edur witness Rhulad’s resurrection as a frightening miracle and accepts him as their Emperor. With the enslaved demon-spirit gods, the shadow wraith (Tiste Andii), and Kenryll’ah demons, the Edur conquer the Letherii Empire village by village until they overrun the capital city, Letheras, itself.
Rhulad simply wanted to be honorable and belong with his older brothers, but insanity had melted all that away.

Hull Beddict was the Sentinel of the Letherii Empire who acted as an ambassador and liaison to the border tribes (Faraed, Nerek, and Tarthenal) to exchange cultures. Hull loved the people of the border tribes, but was naive as the Letherii Empire used his information to take exploit the border tribes and make them indentured slaves and beggars in the streets. Hull spent the rest of his life seeking revenge against the Letherii Empire.

Tehol Beddict was a financial genius and philanthropist that manipulated the Merchant Tolls to gain massive wealth, which he used to purchase islands as refuge for the vulnerable border tribe people. Before the Edur conquered Letheras, Tehol was able to whisk the refugees away to safety on his islands. Although he did not in Midnight Tides, Tehol remains poised to crash the Lether economy.

Bugg is the Elder God of the Sea, Mael, who was bored with eternal existence and loved acting as Tehol’s manservant. Behind the scenes, he ensured the monsters sealed under the Azath tower would be neutralized once the Azath House died, Help Ceda Kuru Qan trap the enslaved demon-spirit god in a frozen lake with the help of a Jaghut huntress, and is poised to beat the Crippled God’s ass towards the end.

Brys Beddict loved his brothers and friends and spent most of the time trying to help them. Helped Tehol when he could and provided a Shavankrat bodyguard. Helped Ceda Kuru Qan with his Tiles. Brys acknowledged he was no match for wits, only felt comfortable with a blade in his hand. Nearly rendered the immortal Rhulad helpless when he severed all of his tendons, but tragically died when he drank from the same poisoned wine of his king who lost faith and commited suicide.
